raw.description:
Job Summary

The Chief Data Officer (CDO) is responsible for the organization's enterprise-wide data strategy, governance, quality, analytics, AI, and data-driven transformation.

Within an Insurance & Investments organization, the CDO ensures that data is treated as a strategic asset across underwriting, claims, customer management, investment/asset management, risk, finance, compliance, and regulatory reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise data strategy and roadmap.

Establish enterprise-wide data governance, ownership, standards, policies, and controls.

Improve data quality, consistency, accuracy, availability, and accessibility.

Lead the organization's data management and data architecture strategy.

Establish data models, data platforms, data warehouses, data lakes, and data integration capabilities.

Lead Business Intelligence (BI), analytics, reporting, and advanced analytics.

Develop and oversee AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics initiatives.

Support data-driven decision-making across insurance, investments, finance, risk, and operations.

Establish data governance frameworks covering data privacy, security, lineage, classification, and access.

Partner with the CIO/CTO and technology teams on data platforms and architecture.

Support regulatory and management reporting through reliable and controlled data.

Develop data capabilities for underwriting, claims, pricing, fraud detection, customer analytics, and risk management.

Support investment teams with portfolio analytics, market data, performance reporting, and investment intelligence.

Establish data KPIs and monitor data quality and governance performance.

Lead data transformation and modernization initiatives.

Manage relationships with data, analytics, AI, and technology vendors.

Build and lead data, analytics, BI, governance, and data-science teams.

Promote an enterprise-wide data-driven culture.

Present data strategy, risks, opportunities, and transformation progress to executive leadership and the Board.

Ideal Candidate Profile

15+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, technology, information management, or financial-services data.

5+ years in CDO, Chief Data Officer, Head of Data, Director of Data, Head of Analytics, or equivalent senior leadership positions.

Experience in insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, wealth management, or financial services preferred.

Strong expertise in:

Enterprise data strategy

Data governance

Data architecture

Data quality & master data

Business intelligence

Advanced analytics

AI / machine learning

Data privacy & security

Data management

Data integration

Regulatory data

Cloud data platforms

Strong understanding of financial-services data and regulatory requirements.

Experience managing enterprise data transformation programs and large multidisciplinary teams.

Strong C-suite, Board, and business stakeholder engagement.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or related discipline; master's degree/MBA preferred.

raw.description:
ÜBER NEOLYMP

Neolymp ist eine Fitnessmarke aus Berlin, die 2018 gegründet wurde und hochwertige Fitnessprodukte entwickelt – von Klimmzugstangen über Fitnessbänder bis hin zu Walking-Pads. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir erfolgreich über Amazon sowie unseren eigenen Onlineshop. Als schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Marke arbeiten wir kontinuierlich daran, unsere Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln und Kompetenzen intern aufzubauen. Ein besonderer Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs sowie der Entwicklung moderner, KI-gestützter Creative-Prozesse.

Als Listing Grafiker (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei uns die komplette operative Grafikarbeit, bist Ansprechpartner für alle grafischen Themen und setzt Briefings aus Marketing und E-Commerce eigenständig um. Du arbeitest alleine als Single-Contributor, ohne Teamverantwortung oder Personalführung. Es geht nicht darum, ein Team zu leiten, sondern darum, Aufgaben selbstständig umzusetzen und sauber abzuarbeiten.

Aufgaben

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Grafik- und Creative-Erstellung: Du entwickelst eigenständig verkaufsstarke Amazon-Listings – von Produktbildern über A+ Content bis hin zu Grafikmodulen – und setzt Briefings aus Marketing und E-Commerce professionell um.
  • Content-Produktion mit KI: Du erstellst hochwertige Creatives mithilfe moderner KI-Tools wie Midjourney oder Firefly und optimierst diese mit Programmen wie Photoshop, Illustrator und Lightroom.
  • E-Commerce-Visuals: Du gestaltest Shop-Banner, Produktsektionen und weitere visuelle Inhalte für unseren Shopify-Store und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Markenpräsenz auf allen Kanälen konsistent und hochwertig erscheint.
  • Analyse & Optimierung: Du analysierst Wettbewerber und Zielgruppen, entwickelst daraus wirkungsvolle Gestaltungskonzepte und setzt diese eigenständig in überzeugende Visuals um.
  • Verantwortung für den Grafikbereich: Als zentrale Ansprechperson für alle grafischen Themen arbeitest du eigenverantwortlich als Single Contributor und unterstützt den Aufbau unseres internen Grafikbereichs sowie KI-basierter Creative-Prozesse.

Qualifikation

DAS SOLLTEST DU MITBRINGEN

  • Erfahrung im Bereich KI-gestützte Content-Erstellung: Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen und hast Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren.
  • Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest gerne in interdisziplinären Teams, bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein und schaffst es, gemeinsam optimale Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Eine offene, wertschätzende Kommunikation ist für dich selbstverständlich und du verstehst es, unterschiedliche Perspektiven konstruktiv zusammenzubringen.
  • Fundierte Design-Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest sicher mit Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator und Lightroom. Kenntnisse in Blender sind ein zusätzliches Plus.
  • E-Commerce-Verständnis: Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im E-Commerce-Umfeld (Amazon, Shopify) oder im Performance Marketing mit und verstehst, wie verkaufsstarke Creatives aufgebaut sein müssen.
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und setzt Briefings zuverlässig in fertige Visual-Pakete um.
  • Gespür für Conversion und Gestaltung: Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis für Conversion-Psychologie, Produktinszenierung und markengerechtes Design.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest vollständig remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du übernimmst den Aufbau unseres Inhouse-Grafikbereichs und gestaltest aktiv den Bereich KI-basierter Creative-Produktion mit.
  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Wenn wir damit dein Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Job Title

CMMS System Administrator

Job Description Summary

The FAMIS 360 CMMS System Administrator plays a critical role in ensuring the successful implementation, configuration, and ongoing management of the FAMIS 360 system within the CW Account. This position involves collaborating with the account team, participating in training sessions, and overseeing system administration tasks. The administrator serves as the primary point of contact for FAMIS 360-related inquiries and support issues.

Job Description

Role Description

  • Participate in transition meetings related to FAMIS 360 and integrated systems (e.g., Yardi, JDE, MEM, Serraview, CoStar).
  • Attend FAMIS 360 training sessions, including guest and full user trainings.
  • Participate in 360 Systems Administrator training sessions.
  • Collaborate with the C&W TDS Delivery Manager and account team during configuration and setup.
  • Configure property settings (accounting codes, language designation, business hours, contacts).
  • Manage user security profiles.
  • Assist with data loading and configuration adjustments.
  • Own the FAMIS 360 system and ensure its proper use and configuration.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for account team members regarding FAMIS 360-related questions and support.
  • Monitor and address system-generated support requests.
  • Support account team users with password resets, security changes, and general inquiries.
  • Coordinate with C&W IT for system issues, maintenance, and enhancements.
  • Inactivate properties no longer managed by C&W (update quarterly billing).
  • Manage user additions and removals based on SOP and SOC compliance.
  • Oversee pick list values and configuration options.
  • Maintain Vendor, Asset, Schedule, Inventory, and other deployed modules.
  • Provide training or coordinate with C&W IT for ongoing training activities.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong understanding of FAMIS 360 and related integrated systems.
  • Self-driven, organized and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in system administration tasks, including user management and configuration.
  • Detail-oriented and proactive in addressing system-related issues.
  • Familiarity with property management and compliance requirements.

Overview

As the healthcare industry shifts to value-based care, quality data abstraction has become critical in identifying positive, patient outcomes. In fact, medical record abstraction is the preferred data collection method for clinical research, quality improvement, performance measurement, disease surveillance, and other secondary data uses. Our Senior Clinical Data Specialists use Q-Centrix proprietary technology to contribute to healthcare’s most exciting advancements.

Job Summary: The Infection Prevention Senior Clinical Data Specialist delivers quality solutions to hospital partners across the country. They approach each hospital engagement as an opportunity to apply their clinical expertise with precision to advance patient outcomes and research. Join our team of Senior Clinical Data Specialists!

Responsibilities

Main Duties/Responsibilities: Our SCDS are staffed with multiple hospital partners to...

  • Apply specialized, clinical knowledge to hospital partners: categorize, code, summarize, interpret and calculate registry/case information from nuanced, patient medical records.
  • Ensure quality submission of all data in specified registries or measure data repositories, maintaining a high accuracy threshold.
  • Prioritize, organize, and meet tight deadlines for multiple concurrent tasks and team requests; uses tact and judgement to manage expectations, flag obstacles and propose solutions in a timely manner.
  • Navigate new technical systems: electronic medical records (EMR) and registry/case entry tools; use team resources to troubleshoot technical issues with systems and applications with a focus on solutions.
  • Contribute to team best practices, data dictionaries, abstraction guidelines, and other business rule documents; identifies process improvement opportunities to help streamline tasks and processes.
  • Keeps up to date on mandated regulatory/publicly reported data requirements as specified by federal, state, payer and other agencies.
  • Any or other additional responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Direct clinical surveillance experience
  • An active CIC certification
  • Exposure to multiple patient medical record systems (EMRs) and clinical databases
  • Intermediate proficiency with MS Office (Microsoft Excel)
  • Applicants for employment with Q-Centrix must be legally authorized to work in the United States now or in the future without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct clinical experience working as an Infection Preventionist
  • RN, LPN, RT RVT, or RCIS credentials

Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to approach problems in a systematic method using the ability to synthesize data and suggest recommendations
  • Demonstrates high standards for accuracy and attention to detail
  • Demonstrates technical savvy and strong desire to learn new systems and technology
  • Thrives working independently and takes ownership of projects/patient records
  • Consistently and clearly communicates, adjusting style and tone as needed to effectively collaborate with hospital partners, peers, team leads and others
  • Demonstrates strong self-organizational and time management skills to concurrently manage multiple accounts, adjusting as needed to shifting timelines and priorities
  • Adapts to changes in hospital partner timelines, requirements, and project assignments
  • Maintains a high degree of responsibility in keeping PHI secure and confidential

Pay Range

USD $30.00 - USD $33.00 /Hr.

raw.description:
About Svetness

Svetness is a nationwide in-home personal training company helping clients achieve their fitness, health, and wellness goals by matching them with certified personal trainers in their local area.

We are growing and looking for a fast, organized, and proactive Personal Trainer Recruiting Specialist / Talent Sourcer to help us source, screen, and schedule qualified personal trainers across the United States.

About the Role

This is a high-volume recruiting and sourcing role focused on building a strong pipeline of personal trainer candidates.

The main responsibility is to source personal trainers through platforms such as Indeed, LinkedIn, Greenhouse, and other recruiting channels, conduct initial phone screens, and schedule qualified candidates for interviews with our onboarding team.

Our clients are actively waiting to be matched with trainers, so speed, organization, communication, and follow-up are critical. The right candidate must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and moving candidates quickly through the pipeline.

Responsibilities

  • Source personal trainer candidates through Indeed, LinkedIn, Greenhouse, and other recruiting platforms.
  • Review candidate profiles, resumes, certifications, experience, location, and availability.
  • Conduct initial phone screens with trainer candidates.
  • Confirm candidate interest, certifications, location coverage, availability, and overall fit.
  • Schedule qualified candidates for interviews with the onboarding team.
  • Maintain accurate notes, candidate statuses, and follow-up activity in Greenhouse or the company recruiting system.
  • Follow up consistently with candidates to reduce drop-off.
  • Prioritize recruiting activity based on markets where Svetness has active client demand.
  • Communicate daily progress, challenges, and pipeline updates to the team.
  • Work quickly while maintaining candidate quality and professionalism.

Requirements

  • Experience sourcing candidates through Indeed is required.
  • Recruiting, staffing, talent sourcing, or appointment-setting experience preferred.
  • Experience recruiting personal trainers, fitness professionals, healthcare workers, field-service providers, or 1099 contractors is strongly preferred.
  • Comfortable making phone calls and conducting candidate phone screens.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple candidates and markets at once.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
  • Experience using Greenhouse, LinkedIn, Indeed, or similar recruiting tools preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and stay accountable to daily activity and results.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of personal training certifications such as NASM, ACE, ISSA, ACSM, NCSF, or similar.
  • Experience recruiting 1099 contractors.
  • Experience working with remote teams.
  • Prior high-volume recruiting or sourcing experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • You are sourcing new personal trainer candidates daily.
  • Qualified candidates are being screened and scheduled quickly.
  • Candidate notes and statuses are updated accurately.
  • Urgent recruiting markets are prioritized based on client demand.
  • The onboarding team has a consistent flow of qualified candidates to interview.
  • The trainer pipeline remains active and moving.

Why Join Svetness

  • Remote 1099 opportunity.
  • Stable monthly compensation.
  • Opportunity to work with a fast-growing national fitness company.
  • Direct impact on client fulfillment and company growth.
  • Mission-driven company focused on making the world a healthier place.
  • Fast-paced environment where execution, speed, and results matter.

Compensation

This is a 1099 contractor position with compensation of up to $2,500 per month, based on experience, availability, and performance.

raw.description:
Job Description: PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA)

Department: Enterprise Security & Technology Risk Management Location: Regionwide

Reports To: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview

The PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) is responsible for ensuring that our client from banking industry complies with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The ISA will assess, monitor, and enforce the security measures necessary to protect cardholder data and maintain PCI compliance across all systems and processes. This role works closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to maintain a secure environment, mitigate risks, and improve overall security posture.

Key Responsibilities:

  • PCI DSS Compliance Management:
    • Conduct regular internal assessments and audits to ensure the organization's compliance with PCI DSS.

Develop and implement PCI compliance policies, procedures, and controls.

  • Serve as the internal point of contact for PCI DSS-related matters and ensure all applicable security controls are in place.
  • Collaborate with the external Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) to facilitate annual PCI DSS certification audits.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation, including policies, procedures, and reports required for PCI DSS compliance.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of assessment findings, corrective actions, and compliance status.
  • Manage the submission of the Self-Assessment Questionnaires (SAQs) and Attestation of Compliance documents (AOCs) as needed.

Flexible, meaningful work. Expert impact when it matters most.

After a distinguished legal career, you may be looking for a role that allows you to continue applying your expertise in a meaningful way, while creating space for other professional interests, board appointments, consulting work, family commitments, or simply a greater sense of balance.

At AFCA, we are seeking Sessional Ombudsmen, Banking & Finance to join our highly regarded decision-making team on a per-engagement basis.

This unique appointment offers the opportunity to remain intellectually challenged and professionally engaged, while contributing to outcomes that have a genuine impact on consumers, small businesses and the financial services sector.

Use your expertise where it matters most

As a Sessional Ombudsman, you will be called upon to assist with complex and significant disputes within banking and finance. Drawing on AFCA's extensive specialist resources, research capability and dispute resolution framework, you will work collaboratively with experienced Ombudsmen, lawyers and industry experts to deliver independent, fair and balanced decisions.

This is an opportunity to focus on what you do best: applying sound judgement, analysing complex legal issues and helping resolve matters of significance.

This is a Board appointed, 3 year term role and can be performed fully remotely.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking accomplished senior lawyers, former Partners, barristers, executive legal leaders and banking & finance professionals who bring deep industry expertise, sound judgement and a strong track record of achievement.

You'll be known for navigating complex legal and commercial issues with credibility, pragmatism and fairness, and have experience in areas such as banking regulation, Banking Codes of Practice, contract law, insolvency, securities, lending and dispute resolution.

You thrive in a flexible, per-engagement environment, communicate with influence and empathy, and can balance independence with collaboration. Most importantly, you're committed to delivering fair, objective outcomes and maintaining the highest standards of integrity and impartiality.

Candidates will hold legal qualifications and have substantial senior-level experience within banking and finance, a tribunal, regulator, external dispute resolution scheme or a related environment.

If you're looking to apply your expertise in a meaningful way while enjoying greater flexibility and balance, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Gold AWEI Accreditation 2025 – Recognised for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion.
  • Accredited Family Friendly Workplace – Supporting work-life balance and inclusivity.
  • Hybrid working – Flexible arrangements with two days a week in our modern offices designed for collaboration and wellbeing.
  • Additional and inclusive leave options – Flexible public holidays, gender affirmation leave, women’s health leave, and bonus paid time off over the end of year holiday period.

To apply

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at .

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

About AFCA

The Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) was established in 2018 as a private not-for-profit ombudsman service providing free, fair and independent help with financial disputes. The original team has grown to over 1600 dedicated professionals. Since 2018, AFCA has received more than 634,000 complaints, helping to secure $2.1 billion in compensation for consumers.

AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.

Fairness feels good

Make a real impact at AFCA. Where fairness drives every decision. Help us deliver world-class, independent complaints resolution for Australians. As a not-for-profit and progressive financial ombudsman, we’re championing positive change. Achieving our purpose takes progressive thinking, accountability and resilience. At AFCA, our inclusive leadership values every voice. We offer our people flexible work options, thoughtful benefits and opportunities to deepen expertise. Flourish in a diverse, caring culture. Feel the difference of belonging to an organisation intentionally designed to put people first.

Our culture fosters a place where skilled, adaptable, and highly resourceful professionals can truly make their mark. We offer a dynamic workplace for employees to grow and develop their skills.

We are looking for a Medical Science Liaison who is the external facing scientific expert in Medical Affairs at Ascendis Pharma that communicates confidently about our products using clinical and scientific expertise. Salary: (UK) £64,226 plus benefits (Our pay philosophy ensures consistency across locations and salaries. The starting salary for this opportunity plus benefits depends on location of the candidate).

The role:

We are recruiting for a values-driven leader to join Mary's Meals International (MMI) as Director of Programme Management. Reporting to our Chief Programmes Officer, you will lead the management, performance and governance of Mary's Meals programmes globally, ensuring effective delivery, strong stewardship and alignment with organisational priorities across our growing movement.

Working closely with Country Directors in our Programme Affiliates, our partner organisations and colleagues across MMI, you will provide leadership across programme performance, planning, budgets, risk management, grants and organisational effectiveness. Acting as a key link between Programmes and other functions, you will ensure programmes are well coordinated, well governed and positioned to deliver sustainable impact at scale.

As a key member of the Programmes leadership team, you will help shape organisational strategy, drive programme performance and lead major programme initiatives that support Mary's Meals' future growth and impact.

You will:

  • Lead the performance, governance and stewardship of Mary's Meals programmes globally, ensuring delivery aligns with organisational priorities and quality standards.
  • Provide leadership, support and direction to the Programme Management team, Country Directors and our programme partners, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance across the movement.
  • Oversee programme planning, budgeting, resource allocation and risk management, ensuring programmes are delivered effectively and sustainably.
  • Act as a key coordination point between Programmes and other organisational functions, strengthening collaboration and delivery of shared priorities.
  • Lead programme oversight of grants, reporting and impact requirements, ensuring strong donor stewardship, accountability and organisational learning.
  • Champion effective programme data, reporting and performance management to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Lead cross-cutting programme initiatives, organisational change projects and programme transformation activities that strengthen programme effectiveness and support future growth.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partners and other stakeholders, representing Mary's Meals at a senior level where required.

About you:

You are a strategic and collaborative leader with significant experience in international development and a proven track record of leading programme management and delivery across complex international programmes or multi-country portfolios. You have successfully translated organisational strategy into effective delivery, driving performance, accountability and impact across diverse operating environments.

You bring substantial experience in programme planning, budgeting, risk management, performance oversight and grant-funded programmes, alongside a strong understanding of governance, safeguarding and compliance. You are comfortable balancing strategic leadership with operational oversight and using programme data, insight and learning to improve performance and inform decision-making.

An accomplished people leader, you have experience developing high-performing, multicultural teams and building strong relationships across functions, cultures and geographies. With excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, you are confident working with senior leaders, country teams and external partners to achieve shared goals.

Above all, you share the vision, mission and values of Mary's Meals and are motivated by the opportunity to help strengthen programme delivery and expand our impact for children around the world.

About Us

Mary's Meals is a global movement supported by people from all walks of life and from all faiths and none. We are focused on one goal: that every child receives a nutritious daily meal in a place of education. Today, more than 3 million children receive Mary's Meals in some of the world's poorest communities.

We are a values-driven organisation that believes in the innate goodness of people, respects the dignity of every human being and family life, and values good stewardship of the resources entrusted to us. In line with our values, we are fully committed to a culture of safeguarding.

We are happy for you to work remotely and flexibly, in a way that best supports your work-life balance. We have an office in Glasgow for those who would like to work from here occasionally or on a regular basis.

We believe in the innate goodness and dignity of every person. In line with this, Mary's Meals is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment. All applicants will be considered fairly and on merit, without discrimination of any kind.

Additional Information

This role will undertake travel to countries where our programmes operate and will involve regulated work with children. You will be required to register with the Protected Vulnerable Group Scheme or local equivalent before undertaking your role.

Our Benefits:

  • 34 days annual leave (pro-rated for part time working patterns) including bank holidays, increasing by 1 day each completed calendar year, to a maximum of 39 days (+ option to buy another week)
  • Flexible working
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Life assurance
  • Medical insurance for candidates located in Kenya, Liberia, Malawi and Zambia
  • Pension - depending on the location of the candidate. For international candidates - any pension contribution paid as part of salary will be subject to normal statutory deductions/ taxation

To Apply

If you are inspired to join our movement and our vision, mission and values resonate with you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please click below to send your CV and a short covering note (no more than one page) telling us why you are a great fit for this role and why you would like to work for Mary’s Meals International.

Closing date for applications is Sunday 25th October 2026.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible

raw.description:
jem & fix växer snabbt och öppnar löpande nya butiker i vårt avlånga land. Därför söker vi nu ytterligare en regionchef till vårt team! Vi söker brett efter vår nästa kollega och placering kan därför vara i Linköpingsområdet, Göteborgsområdet eller nere i Öresundsregionen.

🧰Om rollen:

Som Regionchef på jem & fix har du en nyckelroll i att omsätta företagets övergripande mål till konkreta resultat genom dina butikschefer och deras team. Du ansvarar för att skapa tydliga ramar och förutsättningar för framgång genom att effektivt fördela ansvar och resurser samt säkerställa en strukturerad uppföljning av mål, prestationer och verksamhetens utveckling.

Rollen kräver att du är en person som trivs i en operativ roll och tvekar inte på att vara en närvarande chef för dina medarbetare. En viktig del av rollen är att coacha, stötta och utveckla butikscheferna så de kan leverera en säljklar och välfylld butik. Genom nära dialog, konstruktiv feedback och aktiv sparring bidrar du till att stärka ledarskapet och skapa engagemang som leder till goda resultat.

Du planerar, utvärderar och följer upp verksamheten. Budget och resultatuppföljning ingår i tjänsten. I rollen ansvarar du för att jem & fix:s profil- och verksamhetsmål implementeras konsekvent i regionens butiker och blir en naturlig del av såväl den dagliga driften som kulturen och resultaten. Tillsammans med din region arbetar ni för att behålla och utveckla jem & fix ställning på marknadensom Nordens ledande lågprisbyggmarknad!

Låter detta spännande? Vi tillämpar löpande urval, sök tjänsten redan idag!🚀

Requirements

👤Vi söker dig som:

Är en engagerad, ansvarsfull och prestigelös ledare som trivs med att skapa resultat genom andra. Du har en naturlig förmåga att inspirera, coacha och engagera dina medarbetare samt är tydlig i din kommunikation och ditt ledarskap. Du motiveras av att utveckla människor och ser det som en självklar del av ditt uppdrag att bidra till både individers och verksamhetens framgång.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:

  • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av ledarskap.

  • Är mål- och resultatorienterad med förmåga att omsätta mål till konkreta aktiviteter och resultat.

  • Har ett starkt eget driv och en hög arbetsmoral.

  • Trivs med att ta stort eget ansvar och fatta beslut i vardagen.

  • Har erfarenhet av att planera, samordna och genomföra arbete utifrån uppsatta mål och verksamhetskrav.

  • Har god förmåga att coacha och utveckla medarbetare och ledare.

  • Är strukturerad och arbetar självständigt samtidigt som du skapar goda samarbeten.

Ansvarsområden

  • Omsätta jem & fix strategi och affärsmål till konkreta planer, prioriteringar och mål för regionen samt säkerställa att dessa förstås och drivs vidare genom regionens butikschefer.

  • Skapa rätt förutsättningar för cheferna att lyckas genom tydlig delegering av ansvar, och befogenheter samt löpande uppföljning av mål, resultat och verksamhet.

  • Coacha, vägleda och utveckla regionens ledare genom dialog, sparring, feedback och utvecklingssamtal för att stärka deras ledarskap, kompetens och förmåga att nå resultat.

  • Säkerställa en tydlig ansvarsfördelning och främja samarbete, kunskapsdelning och erfarenhetsutbyte mellan butiker och funktioner i regionen.

  • Prioritera och fördela resurser på ett effektivt sätt för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för verksamheten att nå sina mål.

  • Hantera prestations- och utvecklingsfrågor på ett professionellt och tydligt sätt samt säkerställa att ledare ges rätt stöd och förutsättningar att leva upp till förväntningarna i sina roller.

Meriterande för tjänsten:

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda flera chefer.

  • Arbetslivserfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden.

🛠️Hos oss får du

En informell och professionell organisation som agerar snabbt med korta beslutsvägar, tillit samt frihet under ansvar. Som Regionschef hos jem & fix arbetar du flexibelt, med stöd från engagerade och erfarna kollegor som brinner för detaljhandel och har en lösningsorienterad inställning. En stark kultur som präglas av samarbete, utveckling och framgång. Goda anställningsvillkor och personalförmåner.

Anställningsvillkor

Arbetet är huvudsakligen förlagt måndag-fredag. Helgarbete kan förekomma. Resdagar inom Sverige förekommer och tjänsten kan kräva övernattningar under arbetsveckan. Tjänsten ställer krav på B körkort.

Antal tjänster: 1

Omfattning: Heltid, 40 tim/vecka.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare, med 6 månaders provanställning.

Placering: Anställd på jem & fix huvudkontor i Svalöv, men utgår ifrån hemmet.

Lön: Enligt överenskommelse

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

🛠️Om oss

jem & fix är en lågprisbyggmarknad inom bygg, hem och trädgård. Sedan vi öppnade vår första butik i Sverige 2005 har vi expanderat stadigt och bygger nya butiker löpande. I dagsläget har vi över 200 butiker spridda över Sverige, Danmark och Norge. Det gör oss till Nordens ledande lågprisbyggmarknad.

Övrigt:

Vi samarbetar med Svensk Bakgrundsanalys för en säker rekrytering och trygg arbetsplats. Läs mer om deras tjänster här.

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are seeking a Cloud Solutions Architect to design and govern cloud-native solutions across compute, networking, data, identity, and security domains on a major cloud platform. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, security architects, and engineering teams to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and cost-effective cloud architectures aligned with enterprise standards. The ideal candidate brings strong breadth across modern cloud capabilities, depth in at least one major provider, and the architectural judgment to balance time-to-market, cost, security, and long-term maintainability.

  • Engage with cloud providers and platform partners to evaluate roadmap fit.

Preferred Qualifications

About the Role:

The Talent Acquisition Specialist (TAS) is responsible for acquiring the most qualified employees to meet the staffing needs of the departments supported by the Human Resources Team. Develops new strategies and programs to attract both qualified internal and external candidates to open positions and ensures a constant pipeline of qualified candidates are available for interviewing. This position works closely with the site management team on determining best recruiting strategies, forecasting staffing needs, customizing skill and testing requirements and implementing high quality interviewing selection techniques. This position will also assist with various other Human Resources duties as needed.

What you'll be doing:

  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with hiring managers and other team members to create a partnership that yields success, predictable results, and credibility.
  • Learn and understand each position responsible for filling.
  • Develop and maintain a network of contacts to help identify and source qualified candidates.
  • Build applicant sources by researching and contacting community services, colleges, employment agencies, and internet sites; providing organization information, opportunities, and benefits; making presentations; maintaining rapport.
  • Build and maintain the candidate pool; keeping in touch with applicants to build interest in Percepta for future openings.
  • Post, update and ensure consistency of all internal and external job postings.
  • Leads candidate selection activities including screening, assessment process and interviewing.
  • Review resumes and credentials for appropriateness of skills, experience, and knowledge in relation to position requirements.
  • Provide complete, accurate, and inspiring information to candidates about the company and position.
  • Prescreen candidates and present to hiring managers for interview.
  • Coordinate all communication with candidates.
  • Help with scheduling and logistics of all interviews between candidates and hiring managers.
  • Works closely with hiring managers and peer Talent Acquisition Specialists to ensure a satisfactory interview process, leaving candidates with a great experience.
  • Stay abreast of current legislation and policy changes to ensure recruiting activities follow all processes and procedures outlined by Percepta policies and Federal, State, and Local employment law.
  • Facilitate post-offer process with employees once offer has been accepted.
  • Conduct on-boarding and orientation with new hires.
  • As first point of contact with applicants, fully demonstrate the culture and values of the organization.
  • Progressive and forward thinking on technology and processes to simplify and improve the hiring experience. Subject matter expert for recruiting technologies like TextRecruit, Chatbot functionality, Enboarder, etc.
  • Responsible for forecasting and funnel reporting to measure effectiveness of our recruitment efforts- constantly striving for the best channels and applicant experience.

What you bring to the role:

Education

  • Associate’s Degree required, Bachelor’s preferred.

Experience

  • 3+ years of progressive recruitment experience in a high volume recruitment environment (agency recruiting experience a plus).
  • Knowledge of sourcing techniques using social media and experience using LinkedIn, Twitter and Facebook to identify and engage talent.
  • Strong (and current) knowledge of all laws and regulations pertaining to employment and equal opportunity.

· HR Information System experience.

  • College recruiting experience desirable.
  • Strong organizational, time management, planning and problem solving skills.
  • A strong sense of urgency and the ability to work in an environment with time sensitive deadlines.

Skills

  • Ability to think on their feet and thrives under pressure
  • Manages effectively in a results driven environment
  • Outstanding written and verbal communications skills
  • Must possess strong Internet, active, and passive candidate search skills
  • Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple assignments and excel in a high volume demanding environment
  • Proficiency in HRIS and Applicant Tracking Systems required
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Applications (Word, Excel, Power Point) required

Use your expertise where it matters most

As a Sessional Ombudsman, you will be called upon to assist with complex and significant disputes within banking and finance. Drawing on AFCA's extensive specialist resources, research capability and dispute resolution framework, you will work collaboratively with experienced Ombudsmen, lawyers and industry experts to deliver independent, fair and balanced decisions.

This is an opportunity to focus on what you do best: applying sound judgement, analysing complex legal issues and helping resolve matters of significance.

This is a Board appointed, 3 year term role and can be performed fully remotely.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking accomplished senior lawyers, former Partners, barristers, executive legal leaders and banking & finance professionals who bring deep industry expertise, sound judgement and a strong track record of achievement.

You'll be known for navigating complex legal and commercial issues with credibility, pragmatism and fairness, and have experience in areas such as banking regulation, Banking Codes of Practice, contract law, insolvency, securities, lending and dispute resolution.

You thrive in a flexible, per-engagement environment, communicate with influence and empathy, and can balance independence with collaboration. Most importantly, you're committed to delivering fair, objective outcomes and maintaining the highest standards of integrity and impartiality.

Candidates will hold legal qualifications and have substantial senior-level experience within banking and finance, a tribunal, regulator, external dispute resolution scheme or a related environment.

If you're looking to apply your expertise in a meaningful way while enjoying greater flexibility and balance, we'd love to hear from you.

At AFCA, our inclusive leadership values every voice. We offer our people flexible work options, thoughtful benefits and opportunities to deepen expertise. Flourish in a diverse, caring culture. Ascendis Pharma is a dynamic, fast-growing global biopharmaceutical company with locations in Denmark, Europe, and the United States. Today, we're advancing programs in Endocrinology Rare Disease.

Here at Ascendis, we pride ourselves on exceptional science, visionary leadership, and skilled and passionate colleagues.

Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we use our TransCon® drug development platform to fulfill our mission of developing new and potentially best-in-class therapies to address unmet medical needs.

Our culture fosters a place where skilled, adaptable, and highly resourceful professionals can truly make their mark. We offer a dynamic workplace for employees to grow and develop their skills.

We are looking for a Medical Science Liaison who is the external facing scientific expert in Medical Affairs at Ascendis Pharma that communicates confidently about our products using clinical and scientific expertise. The Medical Science Liaison is responsible for identifying and developing relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and educating all healthcare providers about the disease states and products in the Ascendis Pharma endocrinology pipeline.

The position is remote and reports to the Director, Field Medical Team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the field-based external facing medical representation of Medical Affairs
  • Create awareness of Ascendis Pharma in the endocrinology community and communicate the potential of TransCon technology to transform the practice of endocrinology
  • Maintain high level of medical expertise to support the portfolio/pipeline and relevant disease states (e.g., bone and growth)
  • Provide medical/scientific presentations to both internal and external audiences
  • Identify key opinion leaders (KOLs) and key organizations (e.g. professional associations, patient advocacy groups) for disease states within a geography
  • Identify the scientific needs of healthcare providers (HCPs), researchers, and patient advocates important to patient care within a geography
  • Develop and maintain a KOL engagement plan that foster collaborative relationships within geography
  • Capture external insights about the disease state, Ascendis portfolio and pipeline, and competitors and communicate to internal stakeholders in a timely and effective manner
  • Build strong relationships with internal colleagues (e.g., Market Access, Marketing, and Sales) by providing medical expertise and support as needed
  • Collaborate with Medical Outcomes Scientific Liaisons (MOSLs) to support regional deliverables (e.g., scientific support, internal/external presentations)
  • Participate with the development and implementation of the Field Medical Team strategic goals and objectives
  • Provide scientific support at medical congresses to include participation in clinical data presentations, scientific exchange at the medical affairs booth, and internal or external meetings
  • Provide internal onboarding and ongoing medical training for commercial and medical colleagues
  • Engage with external researchers as a primary contact with interest in investigator-initiated trials (IITs)
  • Support clinical trial operations to ensure success with planned and ongoing clinical trials to include identifying, supporting, and regularly engaging clinical trial investigators, and sites. Participate in patient find activities as needed.
  • Document all relevant activities in the CRM platform
  • Ensure understanding of and maintains compliance with department and corporate policies and procedures

Requirements

  • MD/PhD/PharmD or equivalent
  • Minimum 5+ years of pharmaceutical experience as a medical science liaison required
  • Pediatric endocrinology, endocrinology or rare disease experience preferred
  • Must be outgoing and appreciate the opportunity to interact with healthcare providers and researchers
  • Must have an incredible passion for patients
  • Strong oral and written communication skills with a high capability to understand and effectively communicate scientific and clinical information in virtual and live settings is required
  • Collaborates with a wide range of people to achieve results

Salary: (UK) £64,226 plus benefits (Our pay philosophy ensures consistency across locations and salaries. The starting salary for this opportunity plus benefits depends on location of the candidate).

The role:

We are recruiting for a values-driven leader to join Mary's Meals International (MMI) as Director of Programme Management. Reporting to our Chief Programmes Officer, you will lead the management, performance and governance of Mary's Meals programmes globally, ensuring effective delivery, strong stewardship and alignment with organisational priorities across our growing movement.

Working closely with Country Directors in our Programme Affiliates, our partner organisations and colleagues across MMI, you will provide leadership across programme performance, planning, budgets, risk management, grants and organisational effectiveness. Acting as a key link between Programmes and other functions, you will ensure programmes are well coordinated, well governed and positioned to deliver sustainable impact at scale.

As a key member of the Programmes leadership team, you will help shape organisational strategy, drive programme performance and lead major programme initiatives that support Mary's Meals' future growth and impact.

You will:

  • Lead the performance, governance and stewardship of Mary's Meals programmes globally, ensuring delivery aligns with organisational priorities and quality standards.
  • Provide leadership, support and direction to the Programme Management team, Country Directors and our programme partners, fostering accountability, collaboration and high performance across the movement.
  • Oversee programme planning, budgeting, resource allocation and risk management, ensuring programmes are delivered effectively and sustainably.
  • Act as a key coordination point between Programmes and other organisational functions, strengthening collaboration and delivery of shared priorities.
  • Lead programme oversight of grants, reporting and impact requirements, ensuring strong donor stewardship, accountability and organisational learning.
  • Champion effective programme data, reporting and performance management to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Lead cross-cutting programme initiatives, organisational change projects and programme transformation activities that strengthen programme effectiveness and support future growth.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partners and other stakeholders, representing Mary's Meals at a senior level where required.

About you:

You are a strategic and collaborative leader with significant experience in international development and a proven track record of leading programme management and delivery across complex international programmes or multi-country portfolios. You have successfully translated organisational strategy into effective delivery, driving performance, accountability and impact across diverse operating environments.

You bring substantial experience in programme planning, budgeting, risk management, performance oversight and grant-funded programmes, alongside a strong understanding of governance, safeguarding and compliance. You are comfortable balancing strategic leadership with operational oversight and using programme data, insight and learning to improve performance and inform decision-making.

An accomplished people leader, you have experience developing high-performing, multicultural teams and building strong relationships across functions, cultures and geographies. With excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, you are confident working with senior leaders, country teams and external partners to achieve shared goals.

Above all, you share the vision, mission and values of Mary's Meals and are motivated by the opportunity to help strengthen programme delivery and expand our impact for children around the world.

About Us

Mary's Meals is a global movement supported by people from all walks of life and from all faiths and none. We are focused on one goal: that every child receives a nutritious daily meal in a place of education. Today, more than 3 million children receive Mary's Meals in some of the world's poorest communities.

We are a values-driven organisation that believes in the innate goodness of people, respects the dignity of every human being and family life, and values good stewardship of the resources entrusted to us. In line with our values, we are fully committed to a culture of safeguarding.

We are happy for you to work remotely and flexibly, in a way that best supports your work-life balance. We have an office in Glasgow for those who would like to work from here occasionally or on a regular basis.

We believe in the innate goodness and dignity of every person. In line with this, Mary's Meals is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment. All applicants will be considered fairly and on merit, without discrimination of any kind.

Additional Information

This role will undertake travel to countries where our programmes operate and will involve regulated work with children. You will be required to register with the Protected Vulnerable Group Scheme or local equivalent before undertaking your role.

Our Benefits:

  • 34 days annual leave (pro-rated for part time working patterns) including bank holidays, increasing by 1 day each completed calendar year, to a maximum of 39 days (+ option to buy another week)
  • Flexible working
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Life assurance
  • Medical insurance for candidates located in Kenya, Liberia, Malawi and Zambia
  • Pension - depending on the location of the candidate. For international candidates - any pension contribution paid as part of salary will be subject to normal statutory deductions/ taxation

To Apply

If you are inspired to join our movement and our vision, mission and values resonate with you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please click below to send your CV and a short covering note (no more than one page) telling us why you are a great fit for this role and why you would like to work for Mary’s Meals International.

Closing date for applications is Sunday 25th October 2026.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible

raw.description:
jem & fix växer snabbt och öppnar löpande nya butiker i vårt avlånga land. Därför söker vi nu ytterligare en regionchef till vårt team! Vi söker brett efter vår nästa kollega och placering kan därför vara i Linköpingsområdet, Göteborgsområdet eller nere i Öresundsregionen.

🧰Om rollen:

Som Regionchef på jem & fix har du en nyckelroll i att omsätta företagets övergripande mål till konkreta resultat genom dina butikschefer och deras team. Du ansvarar för att skapa tydliga ramar och förutsättningar för framgång genom att effektivt fördela ansvar och resurser samt säkerställa en strukturerad uppföljning av mål, prestationer och verksamhetens utveckling.

Rollen kräver att du är en person som trivs i en operativ roll och tvekar inte på att vara en närvarande chef för dina medarbetare. En viktig del av rollen är att coacha, stötta och utveckla butikscheferna så de kan leverera en säljklar och välfylld butik. Genom nära dialog, konstruktiv feedback och aktiv sparring bidrar du till att stärka ledarskapet och skapa engagemang som leder till goda resultat.

Du planerar, utvärderar och följer upp verksamheten. Budget och resultatuppföljning ingår i tjänsten. I rollen ansvarar du för att jem & fix:s profil- och verksamhetsmål implementeras konsekvent i regionens butiker och blir en naturlig del av såväl den dagliga driften som kulturen och resultaten. Tillsammans med din region arbetar ni för att behålla och utveckla jem & fix ställning på marknadensom Nordens ledande lågprisbyggmarknad!

Låter detta spännande? Vi tillämpar löpande urval, sök tjänsten redan idag!🚀

Requirements

👤Vi söker dig som:

Är en engagerad, ansvarsfull och prestigelös ledare som trivs med att skapa resultat genom andra. Du har en naturlig förmåga att inspirera, coacha och engagera dina medarbetare samt är tydlig i din kommunikation och ditt ledarskap. Du motiveras av att utveckla människor och ser det som en självklar del av ditt uppdrag att bidra till både individers och verksamhetens framgång.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du:

  • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av ledarskap.

  • Är mål- och resultatorienterad med förmåga att omsätta mål till konkreta aktiviteter och resultat.

  • Har ett starkt eget driv och en hög arbetsmoral.

  • Trivs med att ta stort eget ansvar och fatta beslut i vardagen.

  • Har erfarenhet av att planera, samordna och genomföra arbete utifrån uppsatta mål och verksamhetskrav.

  • Har god förmåga att coacha och utveckla medarbetare och ledare.

  • Är strukturerad och arbetar självständigt samtidigt som du skapar goda samarbeten.

Ansvarsområden

  • Omsätta jem & fix strategi och affärsmål till konkreta planer, prioriteringar och mål för regionen samt säkerställa att dessa förstås och drivs vidare genom regionens butikschefer.

  • Skapa rätt förutsättningar för cheferna att lyckas genom tydlig delegering av ansvar, och befogenheter samt löpande uppföljning av mål, resultat och verksamhet.

  • Coacha, vägleda och utveckla regionens ledare genom dialog, sparring, feedback och utvecklingssamtal för att stärka deras ledarskap, kompetens och förmåga att nå resultat.

  • Säkerställa en tydlig ansvarsfördelning och främja samarbete, kunskapsdelning och erfarenhetsutbyte mellan butiker och funktioner i regionen.

  • Prioritera och fördela resurser på ett effektivt sätt för att skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för verksamheten att nå sina mål.

  • Hantera prestations- och utvecklingsfrågor på ett professionellt och tydligt sätt samt säkerställa att ledare ges rätt stöd och förutsättningar att leva upp till förväntningarna i sina roller.

Meriterande för tjänsten:

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda flera chefer.

  • Arbetslivserfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden.

🛠️Hos oss får du

En informell och professionell organisation som agerar snabbt med korta beslutsvägar, tillit samt frihet under ansvar. Som Regionschef hos jem & fix arbetar du flexibelt, med stöd från engagerade och erfarna kollegor som brinner för detaljhandel och har en lösningsorienterad inställning. En stark kultur som präglas av samarbete, utveckling och framgång. Goda anställningsvillkor och personalförmåner.

Anställningsvillkor

Arbetet är huvudsakligen förlagt måndag-fredag. Helgarbete kan förekomma. Resdagar inom Sverige förekommer och tjänsten kan kräva övernattningar under arbetsveckan. Tjänsten ställer krav på B körkort.

Antal tjänster: 1

Omfattning: Heltid, 40 tim/vecka.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare, med 6 månaders provanställning.

Placering: Anställd på jem & fix huvudkontor i Svalöv, men utgår ifrån hemmet.

Lön: Enligt överenskommelse

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

🛠️Om oss

jem & fix är en lågprisbyggmarknad inom bygg, hem och trädgård. Sedan vi öppnade vår första butik i Sverige 2005 har vi expanderat stadigt och bygger nya butiker löpande. I dagsläget har vi över 200 butiker spridda över Sverige, Danmark och Norge. Det gör oss till Nordens ledande lågprisbyggmarknad.

Övrigt:

Vi samarbetar med Svensk Bakgrundsanalys för en säker rekrytering och trygg arbetsplats. Läs mer om deras tjänster här.

Cloud Solutions Architect – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Solutions Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$190,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Cloud Solutions Architect to design and govern cloud-native solutions across compute, networking, data, identity, and security domains on a major cloud platform. The role partners closely with business stakeholders, security architects, and engineering teams to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and cost-effective cloud architectures aligned with enterprise standards. The ideal candidate brings strong breadth across modern cloud capabilities, depth in at least one major provider, and the architectural judgment to balance time-to-market, cost, security, and long-term maintainability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design end-to-end cloud solutions covering compute, networking, storage, identity, data, and observability layers.
  • Lead solution architecture reviews and approval processes for major cloud initiatives.
  • Define cloud landing zone, account structure, and tagging strategies for new and existing workloads.
  • Establish reference architectures, blueprints, and reusable patterns adopted across engineering teams.
  • Architect security, identity, and compliance controls embedded into the cloud foundation.
  • Design networking topologies including VPC/VNet design, transit hubs, hybrid connectivity, and private endpoints.
  • Lead cloud migration, modernization, and re-platforming initiatives across application portfolios.
  • Drive cost optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps practices across the cloud estate, partnering with finance and engineering teams to make cloud spend transparent, predictable, and tied to delivered business value.
  • Partner with security architects to embed identity, data protection, and compliance controls from the outset.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, sequence diagrams, and decision records.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams during solution delivery.
  • Engage with cloud providers and platform partners to evaluate roadmap fit.
  • Track emerging cloud capabilities and ecosystem developments, assessing relevance to current and planned workloads, and recommend strategic adoption based on demonstrated value and operational maturity.
  • Maintain alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security policies, and regulatory obligations, ensuring that cloud designs satisfy both engineering goals and the broader compliance posture of the organization.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12 or more years of experience in software engineering or solution architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise designing cloud-native solutions on at least one major cloud platform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Experience with cloud migration, modernization, and platform consolidation programs.
  • Strong understanding of containerization, serverless, and managed data services.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience producing formal architecture artifacts and presenting them to senior leadership.
  • Track record of leading architecture reviews and influencing engineering direction.
  • Cloud architecture certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Preferred Qualifications
  • Multiple cloud architecture certifications.

THE FIRM

As a leading international law firm, we are dedicated to excellence through impactful communication, collaboration, and community involvement. Our company culture has earned us one of the "100 Best Companies to Work For" for 27 consecutive years. This honor, along with many others, highlights our commitment to innovation and professional development. At Alston & Bird LLP, our foundation is made of trust, reliability, and compassion.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Hiring Locations:Washington, D.C., New York City, Chicago, Charlotte, Raleigh, Dallas, Atlanta

This position may be performed remotely by qualified candidates who do not reside within commuting distance of one of our office locations.

Alston & Bird LLP is seeking an experienced Billing Coordinator with 2+ years of relevant experience to join our Finance team. This role is responsible for coordinating client invoicing and managing electronic billing across multiple client platforms, including handling complex adjustments to both PDF and electronic invoices.

The Billing Coordinator will interpret and respond to reporting and information requests from attorneys, legal administrative assistants, clients, and other stakeholders. The successful candidate will consistently deliver a high level of client service while ensuring compliance with firm policies and procedures.

This position requires regular communication with firm attorneys, client contacts, legal administrative assistants, and internal teams, both within and outside the firm, and works collaboratively with all members of the Finance department.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of assigned client, attorney, and matter portfolios.

  • Ensure client and matter data is accurately established and updated in a timely manner in accordance with firm policies and procedures; collaborate with the Rates team to confirm correct rate setup.

  • Revise prebills based on billing attorney instructions, post approved changes to the accounting system, and generate client invoices.

  • Ensure all billing requests and instructions comply with firm policies, client guidelines, and ethical standards; audit final invoices prior to client distribution.

  • Track and manage prebills to ensure timely review and processing.

  • Post finalized invoices to the accounting system and ensure all supporting documentation is properly and timely stored in iManage.

  • Manage complex, high-volume billing for assigned clients, attorneys, and/or practice groups.

  • Configure, maintain, and manage electronic billing profiles for assigned e-billing vendors, including new matter setup, timekeeper and rate approvals, task and activity codes, client billing guidelines, and follow-up on accounts receivable and reduced or rejected invoices.

  • Collaborate with Financial System Specialists to fulfill advanced reporting and analytical requests.

  • Oversee all billing activities for assigned electronic billing clients, attorneys, and other complex matters.

  • Monitor accounts receivable, unbilled time, and costs for assigned clients and matters to ensure timely billing and collection; proactively communicate with stakeholders to resolve issues or concerns.

  • Consult with attorneys and legal administrative assistants to identify solutions and best practices for meeting client billing requirements, utilizing the full functionality of the firm’s billing systems.

  • Effectively use reporting and inquiry tools within the firm’s billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and other reporting platforms to respond to information requests from clients, attorneys, and legal administrative assistants.

  • Deliver a high level of professional customer service and maintain positive working relationships with internal and external contacts; engage in routine communication with attorneys, client contacts, legal administrative assistants, and others both within and outside the firm.

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all financial and client information encountered in the course of job responsibilities.

  • Perform special projects and other duties as assigned.

SKILLS NEEDED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

  • Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Advanced electronic billing expertise across multiple client e-billing platforms, including BillBlast setup and maintenance.

  • Proficiency with Aderant Expert legal billing systems.

  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel (e.g., VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data analysis).

  • Proven ability to resolve complex billing issues while adhering to firm policies and procedures.

  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage high-volume work, meet deadlines, and balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated commitment to delivering a high level of professional customer service to partners, legal administrative assistants, and administrative staff.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to interpret and clearly explain complex billing and technical information to diverse audiences.

  • Ability to build and maintain positive working relationships within a team-oriented environment.

  • Thorough understanding of firm and finance department policies, with the ability to identify issues and ensure compliance.

  • Proven ability to maintain strict confidentiality of financial and client information.

  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and collaborate with billing team members and finance management.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • A fast-paced, innovative environment where every day is exciting.

  • A collaborative and diverse culture that values creativity and continuous improvement.

  • Opportunities to engage with firm and the community at large.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree highly preferred.

  • 2+ years of previous experience in legal or professional services billing environment.

  • Knowledge of Aderant Expert and Microsoft Excel.

The salary range for this position is $85,000 - $95,000 and represents the Firm's good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at this time of posting. ABOUT ZINIER

Zinier is on a mission to empower frontline workers — and the people supporting them — to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With 80% of the global workforce being deskless, Zinier's no-code customisation platform drives Technology Equity, improving the lives and productivity of workers who keep the world up and running.

We are a global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India. Our investors include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.

To learn more, check out

ROLE OVERVIEW

Zinier is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join our global 24/7 Support Engineering team. As a front-line custodian of our customer experience, you will provide high-impact technical support across the entire Zinier platform.

To succeed in this role, you should bring strong hands-on expertise in JavaScript development, API integrations, and MySQL or any SQL based DBMS. Expertise in React would be an added bonus. This is an exciting opportunity for engineers who thrive on deep debugging, complex problem-solving, and direct customer engagement—with clear career progression pathways into senior technical or customer-centric roles, such as Senior Software Development Engineer, Solution Developer, Solution Architect and Delivery. For those who are interested in Customer Success, that could be a career path as well. Identify gaps in knowledge-base articles and contribute new documentation to reduce repeat queries. Ideate and implement AI solutions that would help customer experience or improve the product itself. This role will be mapped to customers’ locations across the world and hence would primarily be working in US and EMEA working hours. In future this role might be required to work over weekends as well.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Monitor and respond to customer issues reported over the customer portal tickets or email or slack within defined SLAs.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including workflow misconfigurations, API failures, code based issues and data discrepancies.
  • Investigate logs, trace workflow execution paths, and analyse JSON payloads to isolate breaking logic.
  • Resolve complex requests independently; escalate appropriately when required, with clear documentation of findings and own customer issues end-to-end.
  • File production deployment requests on behalf of customers, coordinating with internal teams.
  • If bandwidth allows, you will be working on Engineering and Implementation/Delivery Projects as well. People with Solution Architecture aspirations will work closely with the sales team(s) as well.
  • Identify gaps in knowledge-base articles and contribute new documentation to reduce repeat queries.
  • Ideate and implement AI solutions that would help customer experience or improve the product itself.
  • Maintain Zinier's high standards for customer communication and response-time adherence.
  • Engage actively in product and technical training to deepen platform knowledge.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and occasional weekend support as required by shift patterns.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 2+ years of experience in JavaScript development, Solutions development, Application Support, Customer Engineering or a related role.
  • Hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, JSON, HTML, and CSS for debugging and configuration analysis.
  • Familiarity with log analysis, REST APIs, and basic SQL queries.
  • Knowledge of operating systems, cloud services, and multi-tier web application architecture.
  • Experience with CRM and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Salesforce) and remote support tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at varying levels of technical expertise.
  • Strong analytical mindset and customer-first orientation.
  • Willingness to work shifts, weekends and 24/7 on-call rotations.

DESIRABLE SKILLS

  • Exposure to Grafana or similar monitoring/observability tools.
  • Experience with workflow-based or field-service management systems.
  • Knowledge of Java, Python, or JEE frameworks.
  • ITIL V3/V4 certification or equivalent foundation in service management.
  • User-level familiarity with Linux environments.

WHY JOIN US

  • Unique opportunity to form a front-facing layer that not only is the front-line to customer deployments, but also has the ability to work closely with Solution Architects and others to influence Product blueprints.
  • Work across the full tech stack — from debugging backend services(Java, spring boot) to exploring front-end interfaces built with React and extending into mobile UI development.
  • Build internal tools, fix production issues, and contribute to engineering stability, all while learning from experienced platform, product and solution engineers.
  • Be part of a high-impact team that bridges engineering and customer experience, where your work helps improve both product quality and customer trust.
  • Join a company that values learning, ownership, and long-term growth.
  • High performers progress to:
    • Senior Software Development Engineer, Support Engineering
    • Solution Developer, Solution Delivery

Role Profile: Scrum Master

Role Summary

The Scrum Master is responsible for enabling Agile practices within the team, ensuring adherence to Scrum principles, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Acting as a servant leader, this role removes impediments, promotes collaboration, and drives successful delivery in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives).
  • Coach team members and stakeholders on Agile principles and the Scrum framework.
  • Identify and remove obstacles to ensure smooth delivery.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to ensure backlog clarity and prioritization.
  • Track and report key metrics (velocity, burndown charts) to stakeholders.
  • Ensure transparency and effective communication across teams and departments.
  • Support scaling Agile practices across multiple teams when required.
  • Drive adoption of Agile best practices and ensure compliance with organizational standards.
  • Mentor new Scrum Masters and contribute to the Agile community within the organization.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination for dependencies and shared deliverables.
  • Assist in defining and refining team goals and objectives aligned with business priorities.
  • Work closely with leadership to identify opportunities for process optimization.
  • Support risk management and proactively address delivery challenges.
  • Champion team health by monitoring workload, morale, and engagement.
  • Ensure proper use of Agile tools and maintain accurate documentation in Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Participate in release planning and help align sprint goals with release objectives.
  • Advocate for continuous learning by organizing workshops, training sessions, and knowledge sharing activities.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Certifications:

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) required.
  • Additional Agile certifications (SAFe, PMI-ACP, ICAgile) are a plus.

Knowledge, Experience & Skills

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Excellent facilitation, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle and project management principles.
  • 3–5 years of experience as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
  • Proven track record of delivering projects in fast-paced, high-pressure settings.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Exposure to scaling frameworks (SAFe, LeSS) is desirable.
