raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About Project Slingshot
Project Slingshot is a global nonprofit organization dedicated to ending factory farming. We do this by exposing the lies, cruelty, and power of Big Ag through disruptive campaigns that cut through the noise, capture public attention, and build unstoppable momentum for change.
We're unapologetic, fast-moving, and impact-driven. We don't just want to participate in the conversation - we want to change it.
The Role
As Digital Marketing Manager (US) you'll be the engine behind Project Slingshot's US digital presence. Reporting to the Digital Marketing Director (US), you'll make sure our channels are fresh, engaging and relentless in driving conversation and action.
This is a hands-on role: you'll oversee content production, manage schedules, nurture our online community, and keep Slingshot at the cutting edge of digital trends. You'll also play a key role in building relationships with influencers and supporters who can amplify our mission. You will know how to turn content into engaging storytelling that expands our audience reach and influences our audiences to take action.
What You'll Do
Content production & scheduling
  • Oversee day-to-day content production (social posts, reels, graphics, short videos) across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and other key platforms.
  • Manage publishing schedules to ensure consistent and timely output.
  • Collaborate with creative and campaign teams to ensure content is on-message, disruptive and engaging.
  • Adapt global campaign assets for US audiences and platform formats.
Community management
  • Monitor and engage with our online community across platforms.
  • Respond promptly to comments, messages and questions in line with Slingshot's bold voice.
  • Proactively build and nurture a strong, active online supporter base.
  • Flag emerging issues, backlash or opportunities to the Marketing Director quickly.
Trends & growth
  • Stay on top of emerging features and trends on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook, with an eye for creative adoption.
  • Explore new platforms (X, Threads, Snapchat, Reddit, Substack) to identify opportunities for growth and engagement.
  • Test and experiment with new methods to capture leads and turn attention into action.
Influencer relationships
  • Identify and cultivate relationships with influencers, creators and advocates aligned with our mission.
  • Manage outreach and collaborations to amplify Slingshot's campaigns.
  • Keep track of partnerships, deliverables and results.
Email & campaign support
  • Support the Marketing Director on email sends, landing pages and supporter journeys.
  • Help build and schedule campaign moments across email and social so they land together.
  • Keep supporter and audience data organized and usable.
Analytics & reporting
  • Monitor social media analytics and report on performance.
  • Use insights to optimize content and engagement strategies.
  • Share learnings and recommendations with the Marketing Director.

Requirements

We'd love someone who:
  • Has experience in digital marketing, social media management or community engagement.
  • Knows TikTok, Instagram and Facebook inside out.
  • Is familiar with other platforms such as X, Threads, Snapchat, Reddit and Substack.
  • Is skilled in content production and scheduling tools (e.g. Agorapulse, Sprout, Meta Business Suite).
  • Understands social media analytics and how to use insights to evolve strategies.
  • Communicates confidently, writes excellent copy and has a feel for impactful storytelling.
  • Is familiar with influencer culture and experienced in building partnerships with creators.
  • Is trend-savvy and excited by new platforms, features and ways to capture attention.
  • Is proactive, fast-moving and comfortable working in a bold, disruptive campaign environment.
  • Brings experience in farmed animal advocacy or nonprofit campaigning.
  • Is passionate about Project Slingshot's mission and hungry to play a part in ending factory farming.
Success looks like
  • Audience size and engagement growing across platforms.
  • Content goes out consistently and on schedule, with quality holding up under pace.
  • Our community is active, well looked after, and growing.
  • A working roster of influencer and creator relationships is delivering real amplification.
  • Social performance is tracked, reported and used to change what we make next.

Benefits

Location & Working Pattern
This role is remote and based in the United States. Project Slingshot is a fully remote organization. Most collaboration happens online, and you will have regular overlap with colleagues in the UK. There will occasionally be opportunities and expectations to travel for team meet-ups, campaign shoots, conferences, planning sessions and other in-person events. Travel costs will be covered by Project Slingshot.

  • Reports to:Digital Marketing Director (US)
  • Compensation:$50,000 - $65,000. Placement within the range is based on experience and location.
  • Benefits:Paid time off, paid holidays, pension contribution
The Application Process

We're looking for an experienced Cloud Architect to join our organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, governance, and cost-effective operation of Ergomed's Cloud (Microsoft Azure) environment. This hands-on role leads the design of new and improvements to existing Azure projects, builds reusable deployment templates and standards, and provides architectural review across the tenant — collaborating with project teams on solution design and standards, with IT stakeholders on demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), and with IT Operations on day-to-day support

  • Lead the architecture of new and existing Azure projects, recommending solutions and reviewing designs to ensure strong, repeatable foundations tailored to meet organizational requirements and business objectives
  • Analyze current infrastructure and applications to identify optimization opportunities, cost reduction strategies, and migration pathways to cloud environments
  • Drive improvements in Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, Advisor reviews, and reservation/commitment strategies.
  • Build and maintain reusable project templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules so new workloads are provisioned consistently and correctly.
  • • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
  • Develop, implement and maintain cloud governance frameworks, security policies, and compliance standards to ensure adherence to industry regulations and organizational standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps engineers, security specialists, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into solution architectures that meets Ergomed's cloud standards and updating those standards where required
  • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
  • Define and maintain tagging, naming, and subscription-structure standards, driving their consistent adoption across the tenant.
  • Work with IT Security and workload teams to achieve and maintain demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), putting the right controls in place so compliance status can be evidenced at any time.
  • Evaluate and recommend cloud technologies, tools, and services that align with organizational needs, including containerization platforms, orchestration systems, and infrastructure-as-code solutions
  • Oversee cloud infrastructure deployments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery capabilities are properly implemented and tested
  • Establish best practices for cloud resource management, including monitoring, performance optimization, and automated provisioning
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development and operations teams on cloud architecture patterns and cloud-native application design

**Required Qualifications:**

  • Extensive experience in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or cloud architecture, with significant hands-on experience designing and running Azure environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in a cloud architecture or senior technical role
  • Deep, hands-on Azure architecture expertise: landing zones, management groups, networking, identity, storage, compute, and security.
  • Proven ability to design and build reusable deployment templates using Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform, ARM).
  • Strong understanding of Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, reservations/savings plans, and Azure Advisor
  • Experience defining and enforcing cloud governance frameworks: Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC, and tagging/naming standards.
  • Experience maintaining compliance against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA, including control implementation and audit evidence.
  • Ability to translate architectural designs into operational requirements, working with IT Operations on support models.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex cloud infrastructure issues.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with GxP and GAMP5 frameworks, and experience supporting regulated (validated) cloud systems.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  • Experience with multi-cloud strategies and hybrid cloud architectures
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps principles
  • Experience with serverless architectures and microservices design patterns
  • Background in enterprise application migration and modernization projects

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Workday Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain integrations between Workday and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on hands-on integration delivery using EIB, Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and Workday APIs, with strong attention to reliability, security, and data quality. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Workday integrations in production, navigates Workday’s tenant model and security framework with confidence, and writes well-structured Studio integrations that are easy to maintain. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop Workday integrations using EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and PECI.
  • Build inbound and outbound integrations connecting Workday with payroll, benefits, IT provisioning, finance, and analytics systems.
  • Develop XSLT transformations within Workday Studio integrations, applying disciplined templating practices, reusable helper libraries, and careful test coverage to keep complex mappings maintainable.
  • Implement integrations using Workday REST and SOAP web services where appropriate.
  • Design error handling, retry, and notification strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Develop and maintain integration system users, ISSGs, security configurations, and tenant-level setup for integrations.
  • Build and maintain calculated fields, custom reports, and report-as-a-service integrations.
  • Implement Workday business processes and condition rules that support integration logic, ensuring the upstream and downstream sides of each integration agree on routing, approvals, and state transitions.
  • Participate actively in Workday tenant refresh planning and integration regression testing, ensuring critical integration paths are exercised in lower environments before each tenant move and any drift is caught early.
  • Collaborate with HR, payroll, IT, and finance stakeholders to translate business needs into integration designs.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Support production incidents related to integrations and drive durable fixes.
  • Participate in Workday release planning and regression testing, reviewing upcoming feature changes for impact, scheduling validation cycles, and coordinating with stakeholders so adoption proceeds smoothly.
  • Stay current with Workday product releases and integration platform evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12 or more years of Workday integration development experience.
  • Deep expertise in EIB, Workday Studio, and Core Connectors.
  • Strong XSLT skills and experience with Workday Studio orchestrations.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Strong understanding of the Workday data model and tenant configuration.
  • Experience with Workday security model including ISU/ISSG patterns.
  • Familiarity with calculated fields and custom report design.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro Integrations certification.
  • Experience with PICOF, PECI, or Cloud Connect for Payroll.
  • Familiarity with Workday Extend.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Experience integrating Workday with major SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce).

raw.excerpt: Turn complex data into clarity.  Build models that businesses can trust.
raw.description:
Turn complex data into clarity. Build models that businesses can trust.

We're a global technology consultancy helping organisations solve complex challenges through modern software solutions, data platforms, AI and intelligent automation.

We're looking for an experienced Data Modeller to join our NZ team. Whether you're an established contractor or looking for your next permanent opportunity, we're open to finding the right fit.

This is an opportunity to work on meaningful client engagements, shaping how organisations structure, govern and use their data to make better decisions.

We're not just looking for someone who can write SQL or build tables. We want someone who understands how to turn complex data into reliable, well-designed models that deliver real business value.

What does the role look like?

You'll spend your time doing what great modellers do: making complex information logical, consistent and genuinely useful.

Working across Microsoft Fabric engagements, you'll turn source data and business requirements into governed, analytics-ready Gold models. One day you might be designing fact and dimension tables, the next resolving data inconsistencies, defining reconciliation rules or collaborating with analysts to ensure reporting delivers accurate, meaningful insights.

You'll work with engineers, BI teams and client stakeholders to understand how data is used, challenge existing structures and design models that are scalable, maintainable and fit for purpose.

This isn't about simply recreating legacy databases in a new platform. We want someone who can think critically about data design, make sound modelling decisions and confidently explain the reasoning behind them.

You'll have the support of experienced colleagues, but we value people who take ownership, ask the right questions and bring solutions to the table.

What we're looking for

Strong dimensional modelling experience is essential. This is a modelling-first role, not a general data engineering or Power BI development position.

Technically, you'll bring:

  • Proven experience designing dimensional and star-schema models, ideally using Kimball methodologies in production environments.
  • Strong SQL skills, including data validation, reconciliation and transformation.
  • Deep understanding of fact grain, dimensions, keys, relationships, SCD Type 1/2 and fact table patterns.
  • Experience translating source mappings and data requirements into governed, analytics-ready models.
  • Experience designing data structures for BI and reporting, ideally including Power BI Semantic Models.
  • Understanding of data quality, lineage, governance and reconciliation as part of good model design.

Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Gold Lakehouses, Delta Lake and Direct Lake is highly desirable. Familiarity with Spark SQL, PySpark and modern CI/CD practices would also be beneficial.

Beyond the technical skills...

We're a consultancy, and how you work matters just as much as what you know.

You'll be someone who:

  • Communicates confidently: Builds trust with clients and can explain complex data concepts in practical, understandable terms.
  • Takes ownership: Makes sound decisions, follows through and delivers quality outcomes without constant direction.
  • Thinks commercially: Understands the business purpose behind the data, not just the technical design.
  • Challenges constructively: Asks good questions, identifies gaps and isn't afraid to recommend a better approach.
  • Adapts and solves problems: Comfortable navigating different client environments, priorities and delivery challenges.
  • Embraces innovation: Brings an AI-first mindset and actively explores better ways of working.
  • Works well with others: Collaborates effectively with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders.

Previous consulting or professional services experience is highly valued, particularly where you've balanced technical quality, stakeholder expectations and delivery commitments.

Why Provoke?

You'll join a collaborative team working with clients across different industries and markets, helping shape modern data and AI solutions.

We value curiosity, accountability and people who get things done. You'll have the flexibility to work your way, support from experienced colleagues and opportunities to keep learning and growing.

A few important details:

  • Location: Anywhere in New Zealand. You must be NZ-based.
  • Engagement: Contract or permanent.
  • Working arrangements: Some availability required to collaborate with US-based clients (Pacific Time).

Interested?

If you're an experienced Data Modeller who enjoys solving complex problems, working with clients and taking pride in the quality of your designs, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and let's talk.

Job Title: People Operations & Development Lead

Company: Pro Coffee Gear

Location: Remote

Full-time

About Us: Pro Coffee Gear is a thriving e-commerce company located on our scenic 20-acre ranch in Austin, Texas. We specialize in providing top-tier espresso machines and related parts to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond our products; we're committed to building a talented team that shares our passion for coffee and exceptional customer service.

About the Role

We’re looking for a People Operations & Development Manager who will design, manage, and continuously improve how we hire, onboard, and develop great people. You’ll be the operational backbone of our talent processes, ensuring every hire is made through a rigorous, data-driven process (using the WHO method), and every team member has a clear development roadmap aligned with company standards and performance expectations.

This role blends strategic HR, people development, and operations. You’ll collaborate with leadership and hiring managers to drive excellence across the full employee lifecycle, from interview and onboarding workflows to ongoing performance and growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hiring & Interview Management

  • Own and manage the WHO hiring process, from scorecard creation to structured interviews and reference checks.

  • Partner with hiring managers to clarify role outcomes and competencies before searches begin.

  • Maintain a consistent, high-quality candidate experience across roles.

  • Train interviewers on the WHO methodology and ensure compliance with scorecard-based decision-making.

2. Onboarding & Integration

  • Create and manage end-to-end onboarding workflows, including:

    • Systems access and setup (email, software, tools)

    • Role-specific onboarding plans and checklists

    • 30/60/90-day success milestones

    • Support hiring managers in setting personal development roadmaps for new hires, tied directly to their hiring scorecards.
    • Monitor onboarding success metrics and continuously improve ramp-up efficiency.

3. People Development & Performance

  • Establish a consistent cadence of performance reviews, feedback sessions, and growth planning across all teams.

  • Coach managers on how to develop, evaluate, and hold their teams accountable to performance standards.
  • Build and maintain company-wide frameworks for:
    • Learning and development initiatives
    • Competency and behavioral standards
    • Track and report on performance health metrics and engagement indicators.
    • Career progression

4. HR Operations & Compliance

  • Manage HR operations such as benefits administration, time-off policies,

    and employee records.
  • Support leadership in managing sensitive HR processes (e.g., promotions, releases, or disciplinary actions).

  • Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policy documentation.

  • Implement and maintain HR systems that support scalability and automation.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR, or Talent Development roles (preferably in growth-stage companies).
  • Deep familiarity with the WHO Hiring Method (Geoff Smart & Randy Street) and scorecard-based hiring.
  • Proven experience designing onboarding programs and performance management systems.
  • Strong coaching, facilitation, and communication skills, able to influence managers and uphold standards.
  • Operationally-minded excels at creating processes, templates, and systems that scale.
  • High integrity and discretion when managing sensitive people matters.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with tools such as Asana, Notion, HubSpot, or similar systems for managing onboarding workflows.
  • Background in leadership development, coaching, or organizational psychology.
  • Knowledge of modern HR software (e.g., Rippling, Gusto, BambooHR, Deel).
  • Prior experience in an e-commerce, operations, or high-growth startup environment.

Success in This Role

You’ll know you’re succeeding when:

  • Every new hire follows a standardized WHO-based hiring and onboarding process.
  • Managers have clear scorecards, structured reviews, and people development roadmaps for their teams.
  • Employees are engaged, performing to high standards, and developing in measurable ways.
  • HR operations run smoothly and proactively, not reactively.

Remote – Precision Oncology Director. The Precision Oncology Director (POD) is a front-line field sales leadership role accountable for building, developing and leading a high-performing field-based sales team, providing strategic direction in adherence with corporate direction and managing all operations related to the sales force. Reporting to EVERSANA leadership and the Client’s Vice President of Commercial Development, the POD will participate in the development of strategic and tactical plans pre-launch and then execute those plans upon approval. In this highly collaborative role, the POD will work cross-functionally with Market Access (NAMs), Commercial Operations, Marketing, and Medical Science Liaison teams to drive the strategy and sales for the Client’s brand, including hiring, training and development, resource planning and allocation, and overall performance management of the sales force.

The Precision Oncology Director will need to understand key business drivers across the nation and coach the Sales Representatives to complete account and targeted HCP calls including oncology nurses, pharmacists, physicians and support staff to increase awareness and appropriate use of the product in patients with FGFR2-Altered cholangiocarcinoma.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for day-to-day management including hiring, training, and motivating a team of Precision Account Managers to achieve or exceed sales objectives with appropriate patients in the US.
  • Conduct regular field visits and business reviews with the Precision Account Managers to ensure that proper programs and messages are being utilized and commitments are met.
  • Create, build, and maintain relationships and regular communication with academic medical centers, cancer institutions, physicians, account influencers and key thought leaders in the US.
  • Oversee management of key accounts, including developing robust account plans prior to launch and quickly transition to effective sales execution post-launch. Ensure a high level of expertise and customer service is delivered to all customers.
  • Expert knowledge of oral specialty pharmacy fulfillment within accounts, organized customers and systems of care, and HUB capabilities.
  • Ensure cooperative and collaborative communication and execution between business partners from field, medical, strategic accounts, MSLs, Market Access, Sales Operations, and Marketing.
  • Responsible for collaborating effectively and mobilizing all appropriate resources toward superior customer support and appropriate patient journey support.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
  • Strategic Thinking in Oncology: Implement strategic plans specific to the brand. This includes understanding the unique challenges and opportunities, as well as the ability to train and coach appropriate sales messaging, territory planning/execution and appropriate patient pull through leading to high performing results.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication skills of the brand’s scientific information to healthcare professionals, oncologists, and other key stakeholders.
  • Adaptability to Oncology Advances: Stay abreast of the latest clinical/disease state/business environment developments in oncology to effectively engage with key accounts and coach team members. Collaborate with and provide relevant insights to marketing, sales leadership, and other key internal partners on local market needs around disease awareness, diagnosis, treatment education, tools, and product messaging.
  • Molecular Testing: Support team understanding of comprehensive molecular profiling for all patients diagnosed with unresectable, advanced, or metastatic biliary tract cancers.
  • All other duties as assigned

PEOPLE LEADER

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities:

  • Responsible for and oversee their respective department.
  • Develop, lead, and facilitate team meetings.
  • Interview, select and supervise the activities of the department staff; communicate interpret and discuss with team the company policies and procedures.
  • Provide regular coaching including written and verbal feedback following customer and field visits that address and support both the business development and career development needs of the team.
  • Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives discussion appraisal with each employee and performance; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline, and discharge and administer all other personnel actions.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field
  • Minimum 7+ years of Regional/Area Management experience of an oncology sales team, preferably within the solid oncology space, people development, cross-functional and demonstrated sales performance.
  • Strong understanding of oncology products, treatment modalities, and the oncology market landscape.
  • Broad cross-functional experience in other commercial roles, such as marketing, sales operations, training, national/corporate accounts, managed markets, hospital markets, etc. is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire top talent, develop and manage employees, and build a successful organization.
  • Coach team members to effectively use marketing initiatives to drive success in the local geography including speaker programs. Coach team members to utilize HCP conferences to reach health care professionals and educate them about the product.
  • Consistently manage to compliance guidelines.
  • Successfully manage completion of all training by team members in a timely manner.
  • In-depth knowledge of oncology treatments, therapeutic areas, and emerging trends in oncology is essential.
  • A proven track record of successfully managing and expanding key accounts. Existing relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), oncologists, and other stakeholders in the oncology field are highly valued.
  • Strong analytical skills for assessing market dynamics, competitor activities, and trends in the oncology space. This includes the ability to gather and interpret data to inform strategic decision-making for the assigned region. Understanding of patient claim data and their importance in identifying patients is key.
  • Significant understanding of oncology reimbursement particularly the oral specialty pharmacy area. Ability to coach representatives working with a Patient Support Service HUB.
  • Strong knowledge of VEEVA systems and Microsoft Office.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced Degree preferred.
  • Experience in gastrointestinal oncology, hepatobiliary cancers, rare disease, molecular diagnostics, precision oncology, or biomarker-driven therapy.
  • Product launch experience, particularly in a rare oncology indication or with an oral specialty product.
  • Established relationships within major academic medical centers, National Cancer Institute-designated cancer centers, or leading regional cancer institutions.
  • Experience working across integrated oncology networks, organized customers, and complex institutional accounts.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS

Patient Minded - I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight - I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action - I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Grow Talent - I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together - I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters - I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity - I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Leidos is seeking a Senior Exercise Planner to lead aspects of HSEEP exercise design, development, conduct, and evaluation for CISA’s National Cyber Exercise Program (NCEP). This role supports the Regional Exercise Lead for their assigned regional exercises and leads aspects such as planning meetings, scenario development, exercise documentation, facilitation, exercise conduct, and exercise evaluation, for multiple concurrent exercises across their region.


If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Leidos’ Homeland Sector’s Airports, Borders, and Security (ABS) business area delivers air travel modernization, border protection, and critical infrastructure security solutions that help build a safer, more resilient homeland. Operating globally across aviation security, passenger screening, cybersecurity, and border and port security, ABS integrates next-generation technologies—including AI-driven analytics, advanced threat detection, and command-and-control platforms—to secure the movement of people and goods worldwide by improving situational awareness, accelerating decisions, and strengthening operational outcomes for customers.


Are you ready to make an impact? Begin your journey of a flourishing and meaningful career, share your resume with us today!


Senior Exercise Planner


Primary Responsibilities Include:

  • Work with the Regional Exercise Lead to determine specific exercise aspects to lead.
  • Lead all activities, documentation, communication, and coordination among the exercise support team for assigned aspect (e.g., scenario, evaluation, exercise documentation, planning meetings, etc.)
  • Communicate and coordinate regularly across exercise support team, with Regional Exercise Lead, and with exercise stakeholders to ensure planning timelines, resources, and staffing are maintained.
  • Participate in initial meetings with Regional Exercise Lead and exercise stakeholders to establish familiarity with the exercise support team, with the stakeholder leads, and to confirm exercise schedules.
  • Lead or support and participate in all planning meetings (as appropriate), such as C&O, IPM, MPM, MSEL Meeting, and FPM, and in developing all supporting documentation, including agendas, presentations, and notes.
  • Lead or support the development of core exercise documentation and artifacts (e.g., CONOPS, EXPLAN, SITMAN, MSEL, COSIN, evaluation forms, invitations/sign-in sheets).
  • Support end-to-end exercise execution: concept and scope, execution support, evaluation approach, and post-exercise reporting (AAR and assigned reports).
  • Report regularly to Regional Exercise Lead and across exercise support team according to communications plan.
  • Attend and participate in each exercise within assigned region as a designated exercise support role to be determined by Regional Exercise Lead and exercise support team requirements.
  • Fill in as Exercise Facilitator if necessary.
  • Support development of new CISA Tabletop Exercise Packages (CTEPs) and maintenance of the CTEP scenario library.
  • Provide SME input to internal training activities to improve facilitation and planning skills across NCEP staff.

Required Experience, Skills, and Education:

  • Ability to obtain CISA EOD.
  • 10+ years experience in HSEEP exercise design, development, conduct, and evaluation.
  • FEMA HSEEP certification required or ability to complete HSEEP certification within 30 days of contract start.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and delivering exercises or exercise-like events that require structured documentation, coordination, and post-event reporting.
  • Strong writing skills to develop polished exercise materials and documents (such as EXPLANs, SITMANs, MSELs, and controller/observer instructions) and post-exercise products (including AAR drafting support).
  • Demonstrated ability to lead high-level meetings, exercise facilitation, and give customer-facing presentations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage time, meet deadlines and milestones, and hold team members accountable to requirements.
  • Ability to meet CISA suitability and the clearance requirement applicable to the assigned role (TS/SCI for designated personnel; otherwise Public Trust fitness type), as described in the SOW.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Education:

  • TS/SCI security clearance
  • FEMA Master Exercise Practitioner (MEP)
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity-focused scenarios and stakeholder engagement across government and private sector partners.
  • Experience contributing to strategic plan maintenance and innovation projects in support of leadership requests.
  • Cybersecurity Certifications
    • CISSP
    • CEH
    • GIAC

About CloudGeometry

CloudGeometry is a Silicon Valley-based cloud-native system integrator with deep expertise across the AWS and CNCF ecosystem. We collaborate with AWS, Google, and Databricks to build next-gen cloud platforms, from generative UIs to MLOps automation. Our global team of engineers and designers work on groundbreaking commercial and open-source initiatives. We thrive on innovation and push the edge of what’s possible with modern tooling, cloud-native design, and intelligent automation.

About the Role

We’re hiring aUX Design Leadto head experience design for a cutting-edge cloud-based AdTech platform enabling local media and digital agencies to run and optimize ad campaigns. You'll lead a team of two designers and own the end-to-end user experience strategy, including building a scalable design system and integrating AI into the design and UX workflows.

This is a strategic yet hands-on role that blends leadership, design excellence, and technical curiosity, ideal for someone who wants to bring structured design processes and AI-powered workflows into a fast-scaling product.


Requirements

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead UX strategy and execution for a digital marketing cloud-platform with complex, multi-role workflows (proposal builder, campaign setup, performance reporting).
  • Manage and mentor two UX/UI designers, fostering craft excellence, growth, and design maturity.
  • Own and evolve a scalable design system that enforces consistency, accessibility, and efficiency across the product.
  • Drive AI integration into UX processes: such as predictive UX flows, user personalization, and Figma plugin automations for speed and quality.
  • Coordinate user research and usability testing efforts; synthesize findings into actionable design improvements.
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into high-fidelity design solutions (journey maps, prototypes, UI specs).
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, QA, and stakeholders in a lean, iterative cycle.
  • Champion design metrics and usability KPIs to align product evolution with business goals.
Must-Have Experience
  • 8+ years in UX/UI for complex web applications; at least 2 years in a design leadership or lead role.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, team leadership, and business impact.
  • Expertise in Figma, design systems (Tokens, Components, Auto-layouts), and workflow optimization tools.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML capabilities in design such as Copilot, ChatGPT, Magician, Diagram, Cursor or any other AI based tool and enthusiasm for leveraging AI to improve user and team experience.
  • Solid grasp of human-centered design, accessibility, responsive frameworks, and design operations (DesignOps, Design System).
  • Ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration, influence roadmaps, and defend design decisions with data.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, able to articulate UX strategy to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Business level presentation skills in English
Bonus Points
  • Experience in martech/adtech, campaign management, or workflow-heavy SaaS systems.
  • Knowledge of AI-powered personalization, adaptive UX, or data visualization principles.
  • Familiarity with analytics dashboards, multi-role UX, or permissions-based UIs.

raw.description:
Vista Government Solutions (VGS) is seeking a Senior Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) to support the Uniformed Services University Health Sciences (USUHS) Network Operations Center Cyber Support Services Task Order. The Senior Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) provides technical cybersecurity and Risk Management Framework (RMF) support for the rewrite and modernization of the Agency's Office 365 (O365) Authorization to Operate (ATO) package. The ISSE evaluates existing authorization documentation, technical configurations, system architecture, security-control implementation, and supporting evidence to develop accurate, complete, and eMASS-ready RMF artifacts. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE The ISSE works in coordination with the Government ISSM and technical stakeholders to ensure that security documentation accurately reflects the implemented O365 environment and applicable DoD and NIST cybersecurity requirements. The Government ISSM retains responsibility for cybersecurity governance, formal risk management oversight, and coordination with the authorization chain. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide oversight and technical guidance to MS InTune and SCCM Endpoint Engineers.
  • Support the comprehensive rewrite and modernization of the Agency's O365 ATO package and associated eMASS documentation.
  • Review existing RMF and Information Assurance documentation to identify outdated, incomplete, duplicative, or technically inaccurate information.
  • Develop and update System Security Plan (SSP) content, security-control implementation statements, POA&M documentation, inheritance mappings, system diagrams, and other required authorization artifacts.
  • Analyze applicable NIST SP 800-53 controls, DoD security requirements, DISA guidance, and inherited enterprise controls to determine documentation and evidence requirements.
  • Review Microsoft 365/O365 configurations and supporting technical artifacts to determine how security controls are implemented within the operational environment.
  • Coordinate with Microsoft 365 engineers, system administrators, endpoint engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and other technical SMEs to collect and validate information required for the ATO package.
  • Review technical evidence and supporting artifacts for completeness, consistency, traceability, and alignment with documented security-control implementation.
  • Document applicable Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM), endpoint security, encryption, continuous monitoring, and Zero Trust capabilities as they relate to the O365 authorization boundary.
  • Identify documentation and evidence gaps and coordinate with appropriate technical stakeholders to support resolution.
  • Support development and maintenance of POA&Ms and associated remediation documentation for identified deficiencies. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE
  • Utilize eMASS to develop, update, organize, and maintain authorization artifacts and supporting evidence.
  • Support the Government ISSM in preparing the O365 authorization package for review by applicable cybersecurity and authorization stakeholders.
  • Address technical documentation deficiencies, questions, and comments identified during Government review of the authorization package.
  • Support development of a technically accurate, complete, traceable, and submission-ready O365 ATO package.
  • Maintain configuration, documentation, and evidence traceability throughout the ATO rewrite effort.
  • Support knowledge transfer and development of repeatable processes for maintaining authorization documentation following completion of the rewrite. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE

What You Bring:

Required:

  • Active Secret clearance.
  • Security+ or higher certification.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Approximately 7–10 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, information assurance, systems security engineering, RMF, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or maintaining RMF authorization packages within DoD or other federal environments.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 security controls and RMF processes.
  • Experience developing and reviewing SSPs, security-control implementation statements, POA&Ms, inheritance documentation, system architecture information, and supporting authorization evidence.
  • Experience with eMASS or a comparable Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform.
  • Ability to analyze technical configurations and translate technical implementation into accurate security-control documentation.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365/O365 enterprise environments and associated security capabilities.
  • Experience working collaboratively with ISSMs, system owners, engineers, administrators, and cybersecurity personnel.
  • Strong technical writing, analytical, documentation, and communication skills. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE

Preferred:

  • Microsoft security certifications such as SC-100, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent Microsoft 365/Azure security credentials are highly desirable. NOC Cyber_PD SR ISSE

What We Offer:

Vista Government Solutions (VGS) offers a competitive benefits package to include: paid holidays, paid time off including sick and vacation leave, medical, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, short and long term disability, company paid life insurance, 401(k) with a company match and discretionary profit sharing and tuition reimbursement.

raw.excerpt: Customer Excellence Group — Product Delivery & Innovation Role overview ServiceNow is standing up a dedicated Communities of Practice function within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG).
raw.description:
Customer Excellence Group — Product Delivery & Innovation

Role overview

ServiceNow is standing up a dedicated Communities of Practice function within the Customer Excellence Group (CEG). This function is designed to multiply expertise across 3,400+ practitioners worldwide. The Director, Community of Practice will own the strategy, design, and day-to-day operation of this community ecosystem, scaling AI and technical readiness across every GEO and every customer-facing role.

This role sits at the convergence of three disciplines - readiness, content standardization, and communities and serves as the amplification layer in the PD&I Readiness Engine. Product experts earn hard-won lessons in the field; the readiness team packages them; you multiply them across CEG so expertise is scaled.

You will report to the Director of Technical Readiness and partner closely with GEO leadership, Product, Engineering, and ServiceNow University to build something CEG has never had: a self-sustaining, accountable system for scaling practitioner expertise at speed.

Relationship to CEG Role & Org Excellence

This role is distinct from, and works in close partnership with, the Director, CEG Role & Org Excellence. That role owns role mandates, competency frameworks, and organizational design - defining what roles exist across CEG and what they are accountable for. This role owns the community operating model -how practitioners build, share, and apply expertise within those roles once they are defined. You will define the competency framework, and you will keep community programming aligned as role mandates evolve.

Key responsibilities

Community strategy and governance

  • Define the community operating model, charter, and success metrics for all communities of practice across CEG- scoped to how practitioners engage and share expertise, not organizational role design or reporting structure
  • Design and implement community types mapped to certification roles/personas.
  • Build the cadence, rituals, and contribution mechanisms (community governance) that keep each community healthy, productive, and self-sustaining over time.
  • Establish community health dashboards with leading and lagging indicators—participation rates, content contribution velocity, certification correlation, and practitioner engagement scores

Practitioner engagement and relationship building

  • Recruit, develop, and support GEO Community Practice Leaders- practitioner-facing roles distinct from GEO Business Leads who embody the practice at the regional level, dedicating approximately two days per month to community leadership
  • Cultivate a global network of practitioner champions who co-author best practices, peer-review, technical readiness and serve as closed feedback loop chairs.
  • Build trusted partnerships across GEO leaders, Product leadership, and PD&I to ensure communities are co-owned rather than centrally imposed
  • Partner with the Director, CEG Role & Org Excellence to ensure community programming reflects current role mandates and competency frameworks as they evolve
  • Maintain an active feedback loop so field lessons flow all the way back to Product, informing the next release cycle

AI readiness and technical enablement at scale

  • Embed AI adoption frameworks, use cases, and best practices into every community channel—making AI readiness a natural part of practitioner workflow, not a separate training event
  • Partner with AI architects and the Product Excellence team to translate technical complexity into community-ready content - adoption frameworks, value realization playbooks, executive briefing guides, and implementation patterns
  • Leverage AI-powered tools (Yoodli simulations, AI-assisted expertise registries, automated field-voice reporting) to scale community operations without proportional headcount
  • Stay current with AI developments across the industry- not just ServiceNow products - and bring external perspectives into community programming

Content and knowledge amplification

  • Operate the fan-out layer of the readiness engine—taking packaged expertise from PD&I and distributing it through communities so a single asset reaches hundreds of practitioners
  • Coordinate with the Content Standardization Lead to ensure community-generated content meets quality, structure, and voice standards
  • Contribute to the repository and discovery mechanisms for community-sourced learning assets, playbooks, and field-tested patterns

Community adoption and behavior change

  • You will partner with the Director of CEG Field Readiness to lead the adoption and behavior change required to make communities of practice stick.
  • Build the executive narrative that makes the value of communities visible and repeatable- linking community health to certification rates, time-to-proficiency, customer outcomes, and revenue impact
  • Present community strategy, progress, and impact to SVP/VP-level audiences, including CEG leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Champion a culture where peer-led learning is valued alongside formal training - making the 70-20-10 model real rather than aspirational

Measurement and continuous improvement

  • Define and track metrics across four dimensions: learning metrics (completion, certification velocity), engagement metrics (monthly active contributors, peer participation), business impact (AI attach rates, implementation cycle time, CSAT), and community sustainability (self-sustaining contribution rates, champion readiness)
  • Run quarterly capability reviews with skills gap analysis to ensure community programming stays ahead of role evolution
  • Report monthly on community health, course correct quickly, and scale what works

Critical skills and competencies

Relationship building

You build trust quickly across levels and functions. You know that community adoption depends on relationships - not mandates - and you have a track record of earning co-ownership from regional leaders in matrixed organizations.

Presentation and executive communication

You present strategy, data, and impact to VP/SVP audiences with clarity and confidence. You tailor your message to the room whether that is a GEO all-hands, a leadership review, or a practitioner workshop.

Influence without authority

You drive outcomes through persuasion, credibility, and coalition-building rather than positional power. You have led practitioner-facing initiatives at enterprise scale where success depended on getting buy-in from leaders who did not report to you - distinct from formal organizational design authority.

Technical community leadership

You have built, scaled, or operated technical communities of practice in large organizations. You understand the mechanics of healthy communities: cadence, rituals, governance, contribution incentives, and sustainability planning.

AI fluency and applied AI experience

You are a practitioner of AI - not just an observer. You use AI tools daily, understand adoption barriers, and can credibly lead AI readiness programming for technical and customer-facing roles. Experience with AI enablement, AI-powered learning platforms, or AI adoption frameworks is essential.

Change management at scale

You have led adoption and behavior-change initiatives that stuck - not just launched. You understand resistance patterns, executive sponsorship models, incentive alignment, and the difference between communication plans and real change management. This is distinct from enterprise organizational design or role architecture, which sits with a separate CEG function.

Enablement Focus/ Learning design sensibility

You do not need to be an instructional designer or a master trainer, but you do understand adult learning frameworks (70-20-10, Bloom’s Taxonomy, spaced repetition) well enough to ensure community programming reinforces rather than duplicates formal learning paths. You have experience with skills and competency frameworks.

Data-driven decision making

You define success metrics before you launch, track leading indicators, and course correct based on evidence. You can build and present dashboards that make community health visible to leadership.

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in enablement, community management, learning and development, or technical program management in enterprise technology organizations
  • 5+ years leading communities of practice, centers of excellence, or practitioner networks at scale (500+ participants across multiple regions)
  • 2+ years of direct experience with AI technologies - either enabling AI adoption across organizations, building AI-powered learning or enablement programs, or leading technical communities focused on AI/ML capabilities
  • Demonstrated success building community programs from scratch in large, matrixed organizations -including defining governance, recruiting volunteer leaders, and sustaining engagement beyond the initial launch
  • Experience presenting strategy and results to VP/SVP-level audiences with measurable business impact
  • Track record of leading change management initiatives that produced durable behavior change - not just awareness campaigns
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience

Preferred

  • Experience building technical certification programs
  • Experience at a top-tier enterprise technology company (SaaS, cloud, platform) in a customer success, professional services, or post-sale organization
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow products, the Now Platform, or the ServiceNow ecosystem
  • Experience with AI-powered enablement tools (e.g., conversation intelligence, AI coaching simulations, adaptive learning platforms)
  • Certifications or formal training in change management (Prosci, ADKAR) or community management (CMX, Community Roundtable)
  • Experience operating hub-and-spoke enablement models across global GEOs
  • Degree in organizational development, learning science, business administration, or a related field

Location and work arrangement

This role supports a flexible work persona. ServiceNow offers flexibility in how and where work is performed, based on the nature of the role and team needs. This position may be based in a ServiceNow hub office or work remotely, with periodic travel to GEO locations and ServiceNow events (estimated 15–20% travel).

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. raw.title: Personalized Support Engineer
raw.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
raw.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Personalized Support Engineer

About the job

The Personalized Support Engineer (PSE) is a member of the Global Personalized support team supporting our top tier customers. They are responsible for handling a variety of Twilio products while also working and collaborating with the Technical Account Managers (TAMs.) The Global PSE team advocates for our TAMs’ customers as if they are their own while providing 24x7x365 coverage, managing specializations and guarding the queue.

This position requires working in a shift, EMEA - 1300-2200 IST. We work 5 days a week, and could include one or both weekend days. (Tue-Sat, Sun-Thur, Mon-Fri etc)

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • BE AN OWNER: Use your strong technical and diplomatic skills to address customer issues and provide customer feedback to Twilio’s Product and Engineering teams.
  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER SHOES: Work with our customers' and partners' developers, architects, and support personnel to resolve problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences.
  • EMPOWER OTHERS: Collaborate with your teammates, the Twilio Product and Engineering teams including filing JIRAs to report reproducible bugs.
  • RUTHLESSLY PRIORITIZE: Be ready to assist our customers when they need us. This position may require working an irregular shift, including the weekend/holidays (Shifts are subject to change based on evolving team and customer needs).

Qualifications

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Fluent in English language (both oral and written)
  • 2+ years’ experience in a client-facing technical role, preferably in supporting REST API and ability to understand and troubleshoot issues with cloud solutions.
  • Experience working with top tier customers.
  • Supporting customers with service level agreements (SLAs) of 3 hours or less, utilizing a ticket system such as Zendesk.
  • Excellence in task prioritization and evaluation of situational urgency.
  • Advanced time management skills and proficiency at developing workflows to increase troubleshooting efficiency while still following standard processes and procedures.
  • Ability to stand in the customer’s shoes and demonstrated dedication to the customer experience.
  • Enthusiasm for interacting and collaborating with other departments within Twilio in your search for the solutions our customers need.

Desired:

  • Previous exposure or knowledge of Twilio products
  • Experience working with JIRA, Confluence, Airtable and other project tools.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting network connectivity issues
  • Prior telecom (Carrier, SIP, PBX) including reviewing PCAPs/using Wireshark or messaging platform experience

Location

This role will be remotely based in India(Karanatka, Telangana, Delhi, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra)

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior Routing Engine Developer to design and build the next generation interaction routing platform powering enterprise-scale contact center operation. You will develop the core routing engine responsible for intelligent distribution of voice and digital interactions across agents, queues, skills, channels, and business units in real time. The role includes building highly scalable backend services capable of processing large volumes of routing decisions with strict latency, availability, and resiliency requirements. You will work primarily with Java, Spring Boot, distributed architectures, event-driven systems, and cloud-native technologies, collaborating closely with product, architecture, workforce management, telephony, and CX platform teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop enterprise-scale routing engines that distribute voice and digital interactions in real time.
  • Implement intelligent routing algorithms based on skills, priorities, capacity, availability, and business rules.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, resilience, and performance across queues, routing paths, and interaction workloads.
  • Design and maintain APIs supporting routing configuration, administration, monitoring, and integration requirements.
  • Optimize systems for high concurrency, fault tolerance, resiliency, and predictable performance.
  • Integrate routing services with telephony, digital messaging, workforce management, CRM, identity, reporting, and analytics platforms.
  • Design and develop critical Java and Spring Boot services, APIs, integration components, and reference implementations.
  • Translate business journeys and operational requirements into solution components, interaction flows, deployment views, and technical roadmaps.
  • Define non-functional requirements for availability, performance, concurrency, security, privacy, observability, disaster recovery, and supportability.
  • Review designs and code, identify technical risks, challenge assumptions, and drive pragmatic decisions that balance quality, time, and cost.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, quality gates, documentation expectations, and technology adoption guidance.
  • Collaborate with CX domain experts to translate operational requirements into routing capabilities.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of architecture and technical delivery for distributed applications.
  • Expert-level hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, implementing distributed systems and microservices architectures, REST APIs, persistence, security, testing, and performance engineering.
  • Experience developing routing logic for contact center, communications, or customer engagement platforms.
  • Knowledge of ACD concepts, agent states, queue management, skill-based routing, priority routing, proficiency routing, and workload balancing.
  • Experience building high-throughput, low-latency transaction processing systems.Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven architecture, messaging, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases, data modeling, integration data flows, and transactional design.
  • Hands-on experience with contact center or CX platforms and the operational concepts behind customer routing and engagement.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical documentation and lead client-facing workshops.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time communications platforms such as FreeSWITCH or Kamailio.
  • Knowledge of optimization algorithms, decision engines, or scheduling systems.
  • Experience with Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Avaya, or comparable contact center platforms.
  • Exposure to WFM processes and integrations involving forecasting, schedules, adherence, etc.
  • Familiarity with Kafka or RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, Jenkins, observability platforms, API gateways, and security architecture.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development or AI-enabled solutions, including tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot, is a plus.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Purpose Summary


To design, build, support and maintain scalable, reliable data solutions that enable the business to make timely, data-driven decisions. This role owns the data pipelines, integrations and analytics tooling — including Snowflake and Power BI — that underpin reporting and analytics across the organisation, working closely with the Development, Cloud and Security engineering teams to ensure data solutions are delivered securely, reliably and efficiently. The role is forward-looking, embracing AI-assisted tooling to accelerate delivery and improve data quality, while maintaining strong working knowledge of existing data tooling to support and maintain legacy data integrations and solutions.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • I design, build, support and maintain scalable, secure data pipelines and integrations across the organisation's data estate.
  • I develop and maintain data models, ETL/ELT pipelines and analytics solutions using Azure Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Power BI and related data tooling.
  • I take accountability for the quality, performance and ongoing support of the data solutions I deliver, including legacy data integrations.
  • I champion effective and responsible use of AI-assisted tooling (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude) to improve the speed, quality and efficiency of data engineering delivery.
  • I work closely with the Development, Cloud and Security engineering teams to ensure data solutions are architected, delivered and operated securely and reliably.
  • I troubleshoot and resolve complex data issues, including data quality, performance and integration failures, across both modern and legacy platforms.
  • I maintain and support existing legacy data integrations and solutions, ensuring continuity of service while planning their modernisation where appropriate.
  • I build and maintain dashboards, reports and self-service analytics capability in Power BI for business stakeholders.
  • I liaise with business stakeholders to understand data and reporting requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • I adopt a security-first approach to the data solutions I design and build, ensuring data is handled in line with governance, privacy and compliance requirements.
  • I contribute to the definition and evolution of data architecture, standards and best practice across the organisation.
  • I can accurately estimate the time and effort required for data engineering tasks and projects.
  • I partner with the Cloud and Development teams to ensure data platforms scale effectively within our cloud infrastructure.
  • The employee agrees to take on additional reasonable tasks that align with their abilities, if required.

Experience and Educational Requirements

  • Experience working with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and cloud-native data services.
