Position Summary
The Vice President, Strategic Growth and Sales leads DataSpring's commercial growth strategy and sales organization, with responsibility for driving sustainable revenue growth, expanding existing client relationships, developing new markets, and building the capabilities required to support the company's long-term growth objectives. This executive oversees enterprise sales, sales enablement, and channel partnerships, and works closely with leaders across Product, Marketing, Client Partnerships, and Revenue Operations to align go-to-market strategy and execution.

The Vice President is accountable for achievement of annual revenue, growth, and client acquisition objectives. The leader identifies and pursues new growth opportunities, shapes commercialization strategies for emerging solutions, strengthens strategic partnerships, and builds a high-performing commercial organization capable of scaling with the business. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational rigor and has a demonstrated track record of translating market opportunities into sustainable growth.

The VP, Strategic Growth and Sales is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the CGO

Specific Responsibilities

Strategic Growth Leadership

  • Develop and execute a multi-year commercial growth strategy aligned with DataSpring's strategic objectives.
  • Identify and prioritize new market opportunities, customer segments, and growth vectors across the healthcare ecosystem.
  • Partner with executive leadership to shape commercialization strategies for emerging products, solutions, and data assets.
  • Assess market trends, competitive dynamics, and customer needs to inform growth priorities and investment decisions.
  • Serve as a key advisor to executive leadership on commercial strategy and growth opportunities.

Sales Leadership & Revenue Growth

  • Lead the enterprise sales organization and drive achievement of revenue, growth, and client acquisition objectives.
  • Establish sales strategies, coverage models, and performance expectations that support sustainable growth.
  • Provide executive leadership for strategic opportunities, complex negotiations, and key client relationships.
  • Drive disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, and sales execution across the commercial organization.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.

Channel Partnerships & Market Expansion

  • With the Director, Channel Partnerships, develop and execute a partnership strategy that expands market reach and accelerates growth.
  • Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships that create new distribution channels, market access opportunities, and revenue streams.
  • Establish partnership frameworks and success metrics to maximize long-term value.
  • Develop joint go-to-market and co-selling strategies with strategic partners.

Commercial Capability Building & Sales Enablement

  • With the Director, Sales Enablement, lead onboarding, training, coaching, sales methodologies, and performance development programs.
  • Ensure the commercial organization has the tools, content, insights, and capabilities needed to succeed.
  • Establish best practices and repeatable processes that improve sales effectiveness and scalability.
  • Develop future commercial leaders through coaching, mentorship, and succession planning.

Cross-Functional Go-to-Market Leadership

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Client Partnerships, Legal, and Revenue Operations leaders to align commercial strategy and execution.
  • Translate market feedback and customer insights into recommendations for product, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations to strengthen demand generation, forecasting, performance visibility, and commercial decision-making.
  • Foster alignment across functions to deliver a consistent and scalable client experience.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Directly and indirectly manage a multi-disciplinary sales, partnerships and growth enablement team.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and development for senior sales leaders and individual contributors.

Skills

  • Proven ability to develop and execute commercial growth strategies that drive sustainable revenue growth.
  • Strong strategic thinking and market assessment capabilities.
  • Experience building, leading, and developing high-performing commercial teams.
  • Deep expertise in consultative selling, enterprise account management, and healthcare solution sales.
  • Ability to influence and align cross-functional teams across Product, Marketing, Client Partnerships, and Revenue Operations.
  • Strong financial, analytical, and business planning skills.
  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and stakeholder management capabilities.

Experience

  • 12+ years of experience selling complex technology, data, or SaaS solutions.
  • 7+ years of progressive sales leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success selling into healthcare payers, providers, or adjacent markets.
  • Experience leading commercial transformation within healthcare technology, data, SaaS, or information-services organization.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Marketing, or a related field required.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income, place of residence, or any other characteristic protected by law. DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Applicants have rights under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA),Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), and the Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA). If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a posted position, please contact the DataSpring People & Culture team at or 202-517-0436.

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Financial Controller

Compensation range: $3,500 AUD - $4,500 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: 8:30 AM– 5:00 PM Queensland Time (AEST, UTC+10) / 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM Manila, Monday to Friday, no daylight-saving shift

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established Australian distribution business working with a portfolio of international and local suppliers and a growing network of retail and commercial partners across the country.

The business is focused on building a reliable, well-managed supply operation that supports its customers and partners through consistent product availability, strong supplier relationships, and efficient internal processes. As the company continues to grow, it is investing in better systems, planning, and operational structure to support the next stage of the business.

Role Overview: The Financial Controller owns the accounts function end to end: accurate books every day, a clean close by working day 5 every month, and a management pack, rolling three-way forecast and 13-week cash forecast the business is run against. Until the Senior Bookkeeper is hired, the Controller performs the transactional work personally; after that hire, the Controller supervises it and spends the freed time on analysis, controls and insight.

This is an ownership role. The Controller decides the exceptions (the unmatched supplier invoice, the disputed dealer credit, the landed cost that does not tie to the shipment) rather than escalating them, and is accountable for the numbers being right. Board-level judgement work, including capital allocation cases, lender and investor packs, acquisition due diligence and scenario modelling, sits with the CEO and the fractional CFO; the Controller supplies the numbers and the first draft.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Bank and cards: Daily reconciliation of all bank and card accounts across AUD, USD, EUR and other trading currencies using bank feeds and matching rules; clear exceptions the same day.
  • Accounts Payable: Enter supplier invoices; three-way match of purchase order, goods receipt and invoice on inventory purchases; code indirect expenses; prepare payment-run schedules for CEO approval; maintain supplier master data and terms; manage supplier prepayments and settlement timing.
  • Accounts Receivable and credit: Allocate customer receipts; issue statements; prepare overdue lists and reminder correspondence; set and apply customer credit limits and overdue thresholds within policy; provide a weekly exposure dashboard to the Customer Service Manager.
  • Expenses, cards and payroll: Reconcile corporate cards and expense claims; prepare payroll data for review; reconcile superannuation and leave balances.
  • Inventory and landed cost: Post goods receipts and landed-cost allocations (freight, duty, insurance); stock valuation; slow-moving and obsolete stock provisions; reconcile system inventory to physical counts with the Warehouse Coordinator.
  • Month-end close: Reconciliations and schedules by working day 3 (bank, AP, AR, prepayments, accruals, fixed assets, GST); close by working day 5; monthly management pack with P&L by brand and channel, balance sheet, cash, inventory days, DSO/DPO and a one-page narrative.
  • Budgets, forecasts and variance: Build the annual budget with each manager for CEO approval; maintain a rolling 12-month three-way model re-forecast quarterly; own the 13-week cash forecast; monthly budget-versus-actual by department and brand with root causes and corrective actions agreed with the responsible manager.
  • Commercial insight: Gross margin by brand, channel, customer and product at landed cost; fixed versus variable cost and breakeven by brand; support Sales and Brand Management on pricing, rebates and supplier terms with numbers.
  • Foreign exchange: Execute FX transactions and track open positions within the company’s FX Risk Management Policy; monthly revaluation of open foreign-currency balances.
  • Controls and compliance: Segregation of duties and delegation-of-authority matrix; audit trail in NetSuite; quarterly fraud and leakage review; prepare BAS, FBT, payroll tax, ASIC and year-end working papers for the Australian accountants and manage their annual review; fixed-asset register.
  • NetSuite and systems: Own the NetSuite finance module: cleanse MYOB data (debtors, creditors, open purchase orders, unreconciled items), load and verify opening balances, chart of accounts, roles and approvals, bank feeds, saved searches and reports; specify Power BI finance reporting; specify and supervise AI-assisted workflows for bank reconciliation, collections and report drafting; document every recurring process.
  • Procurement interface: Line-manage the Procurement & Supply Chain Manager; approve purchase orders outside the budget envelope; receive the procurement document pack and process payments (Procurement raises no payments).
  • People: Select, onboard and lead the Senior Bookkeeper when the trigger is reached; train managers to read and own their own numbers.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Philippine CPA (Australian CPA or CA an advantage).
  • Minimum 8 years in accounting, including at least 3 in a product-based business (wholesale, distribution, import, retail or manufacturing) with hands-on inventory, landed-cost and multi-currency accounting.
  • Has worked for an Australian or New Zealand business or client: understands BAS/GST coding, superannuation, payroll tax and the 1 July – 30 June financial year.
  • Has personally run a monthly close end to end and produced a management pack for an owner or managing director.
  • Has built or maintained a budget and a rolling three-way model (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and run monthly variance reviews with operating managers.
  • Hands-on NetSuite experience in the finance module (AP, AR, bank reconciliation, period close). Experience on a NetSuite migration or data-cleansing project is strongly preferred; MYOB experience is an advantage.
  • Decides exceptions rather than escalating them, and can show it with examples.
  • Builds systems: documents processes without being asked; has used automation or AI tools in finance work.
  • Strong written and spoken English; comfortable presenting numbers to a CEO and a management team and disagreeing in writing when the numbers call for it.

Nice to Have:

  • Led the finance side of a NetSuite go-live, including opening-balance reconciliation.
  • NetSuite OneWorld, multi-subsidiary or consolidation exposure.
  • Power BI or NetSuite SuiteAnalytics.
  • Has supervised a bookkeeper or small finance team across time zones.
  • Experience with Australian customs, Deferred GST and import documentation.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Junior Business Analyst(Data & Integration) with a strong data analysis background to support NOAA Fisheries data mapping, interoperability requirements, and compliance documentation on a federal data integration program. This role focuses on the technical business analysis activities that bridge data engineering and regulatory compliance.

The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Work Location: Remote

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Conduct detailed source-to-target data mapping analysis for NOAA Fisheries species datasets, documenting field-level transformation rules, data type conversions, and null-handling logic.
  • Analyze NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion and document remediation requirements.
  • Support the Metadata and Authoritative Source Registry by researching and documenting NOAA Fisheries data source attributes, refresh cadences, and data stewardship contacts.
  • Assist in the development and documentation of interoperability testing requirements including API connectivity, data exchange protocols, and metadata alignment test cases.
  • Support compliance validation checklist development by documenting validation criteria for species list generation, decision logic, and template content completeness.
  • Analyze live consultation feedback from production and document actionable requirements for system updates.
  • Support the Prototype Ingest Results Report by documenting NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion, including defect descriptions, root cause analysis, and remediation requirements.
  • Assist in the development of training metrics dashboard requirements and reporting specifications.
  • Support the compilation of final operational documentation by documenting NOAA Fisheries data refresh procedures.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree and 0 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree and 4 years of professional experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 6 years of professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
  • Experience supporting business analysis experience with a focus on data integration or data migration programs.
  • Experience with source-to-target data mapping and data quality analysis.
  • Familiarity with API integration concepts and interoperability testing requirements.
  • Strong analytical and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting federal IT programs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with NOAA Fisheries or other federal environmental data systems.
  • Familiarity with ETL concepts, data pipelines, or cloud data platforms.
  • Experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal programs.
  • Experience contributing to program status reports or monthly progress reports.
  • ECBA or CCBA certification.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

$51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

raw.excerpt: About VantageVantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises.
raw.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


Product Engineering Department

The Product Engineering team is building a repeatable, product-led approach to designing, delivering, and operating data centers at a global scale. The team partners across architecture, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, construction, and regional delivery functions to develop scalable solutions that improve reliability, constructability, speed-to-market, and operational performance.


Position Overview

This role can be based in Denver, CO following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office, 2 days flexible). Or US remote.

Vantage is seeking a Principal Structural Engineer to lead structural design for mission-critical data center facilities, with a strong emphasis on prefabricated and modular construction methods.

This is a Principal-level technical leadership role for an experienced engineer who can set structural strategy, establish design standards, and guide complex structural decisions from concept through construction. The role will balance speed-to-market and constructability with the rigorous safety, reliability, and performance requirements of data center infrastructure.

The Principal Structural Engineer will serve as the technical authority for structural design across foundations, steel and concrete framing, floor systems, equipment support structures, and modular deployments supporting data center builds, expansions, and retrofit programs.

This position is remote within the United States, with travel required for site visits, construction observations, and visits to fabrication facilities.


Essential Job Functions

  • Provide Principal-level technical expertise for the structural design of foundations, structural framing, and floor systems supporting data center builds, expansions, retrofits, and modular deployments.
  • Establish structural requirements, reference design approaches, technical standards, and design guardrails that can be applied across data center platforms and multiple jurisdictions.
  • Design structural systems optimized for prefabricated and modular construction, including modular skids, precast components, factory-built PODs, and off-site assembled MEP yards.
  • Incorporate requirements for off-site manufacturing, transportation, lifting, rigging, installation, tolerances, and interfaces between factory-built modules and site-built infrastructure.
  • Review and perform load analyses for raised floors, equipment racks, generators, cooling infrastructure, and rooftop or ground-mounted mechanical equipment.
  • Set technical direction for seismic, wind, and building-code compliance strategies across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate with architectural, civil, MEP, manufacturing, and fabrication partners to integrate structural designs into prefabricated delivery workflows.
  • Lead structural design reviews, shop drawing reviews, constructability assessments, and the resolution of complex structural interface issues.
  • Review fabricator calculations, shop drawings, and submittals, resolving tolerance and interface challenges between prefabricated modules and site-built structures.
  • Lead constructability and value-engineering reviews focused on modular sequencing, transportation logistics, installation constraints, safety, reliability, and speed-to-market.
  • Evaluate existing facilities and develop practical structural solutions for upgrades supporting increased power and cooling density.
  • Partner with Product Engineering, construction, manufacturing, and regional delivery teams to improve cross-functional alignment and technical execution.
  • Mentor engineers, elevate structural design quality, and establish disciplined review practices for calculations, design packages, and technical decisions.
  • Conduct site visits, construction observations, and visits to fabrication and off-site manufacturing facilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer license required.
  • 10 or more years of structural engineering experience.
  • At least four years of structural engineering experience supporting data centers or other mission-critical facilities.
  • Hands-on experience designing structural systems for modular or prefabricated construction.
  • Demonstrated experience designing foundations, steel and concrete framing, floor systems, and equipment support structures.
  • Experience with foundations supporting heavy equipment with varying vibration, movement, and operational requirements.
  • Experience managing structural requirements associated with the transportation, lifting, and rigging of prefabricated modules.
  • Deep working knowledge of ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC, IBC, and other applicable structural design standards and building codes.
  • Proficiency with structural analysis and design software such as ETABS, SAP2000, RISA, or RAM.
  • Strong knowledge of seismic and wind design requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience reviewing structural calculations, design packages, fabricator shop drawings, technical submittals, and construction documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical decisions and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, technical problem-solving, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, priorities, and technical workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel for construction observations, site visits, and visits to fabrication facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Structural Engineer license, particularly for work within high-seismic markets.
  • Direct experience partnering with modular fabricators or off-site manufacturing facilities.
  • Experience leading structural design across multiple concurrent hyperscale or colocation data center projects.
  • Revit and BIM coordination experience, including clash detection across prefabricated and site-built interfaces.
  • Experience coordinating structural systems that support physical security, equipment movement, move-in and move-out requirements, prefabrication, and other trades.
  • Experience developing repeatable structural standards and reference designs for use across multiple projects or global platforms.
  • Experience supporting retrofit projects and infrastructure upgrades within operating mission-critical facilities.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $170,000- $175,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)
  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.
  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

#CM-1


We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.


Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.


Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

raw.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Junior Business Analyst(Data & Integration) with a strong data analysis background to support NOAA Fisheries data mapping, interoperability requirements, and compliance documentation on a federal data integration program. This role focuses on the technical business analysis activities that bridge data engineering and regulatory compliance.

The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Work Location: Remote

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Conduct detailed source-to-target data mapping analysis for NOAA Fisheries species datasets, documenting field-level transformation rules, data type conversions, and null-handling logic.
  • Analyze NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion and document remediation requirements.
  • Support the Metadata and Authoritative Source Registry by researching and documenting NOAA Fisheries data source attributes, refresh cadences, and data stewardship contacts.
  • Assist in the development and documentation of interoperability testing requirements including API connectivity, data exchange protocols, and metadata alignment test cases.
  • Support compliance validation checklist development by documenting validation criteria for species list generation, decision logic, and template content completeness.
  • Analyze live consultation feedback from production and document actionable requirements for system updates.
  • Support the Prototype Ingest Results Report by documenting NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion, including defect descriptions, root cause analysis, and remediation requirements.
  • Assist in the development of training metrics dashboard requirements and reporting specifications.
  • Support the compilation of final operational documentation by documenting NOAA Fisheries data refresh procedures.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree and 0 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree and 4 years of professional experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 6 years of professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
  • Experience supporting business analysis experience with a focus on data integration or data migration programs.
  • Experience with source-to-target data mapping and data quality analysis.
  • Familiarity with API integration concepts and interoperability testing requirements.
  • Strong analytical and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting federal IT programs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with NOAA Fisheries or other federal environmental data systems.
  • Familiarity with ETL concepts, data pipelines, or cloud data platforms.
  • Experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal programs.
  • Experience contributing to program status reports or monthly progress reports.
  • ECBA or CCBA certification.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

$51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

raw.excerpt: About VantageVantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises.
raw.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


Product Engineering Department

The Product Engineering team is building a repeatable, product-led approach to designing, delivering, and operating data centers at a global scale. The team partners across architecture, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, construction, and regional delivery functions to develop scalable solutions that improve reliability, constructability, speed-to-market, and operational performance.


Position Overview

This role can be based in Denver, CO following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office, 2 days flexible). Or US remote.

Vantage is seeking a Principal Structural Engineer to lead structural design for mission-critical data center facilities, with a strong emphasis on prefabricated and modular construction methods.

This is a Principal-level technical leadership role for an experienced engineer who can set structural strategy, establish design standards, and guide complex structural decisions from concept through construction. The role will balance speed-to-market and constructability with the rigorous safety, reliability, and performance requirements of data center infrastructure.

The Principal Structural Engineer will serve as the technical authority for structural design across foundations, steel and concrete framing, floor systems, equipment support structures, and modular deployments supporting data center builds, expansions, and retrofit programs.

This position is remote within the United States, with travel required for site visits, construction observations, and visits to fabrication facilities.


Essential Job Functions

  • Provide Principal-level technical expertise for the structural design of foundations, structural framing, and floor systems supporting data center builds, expansions, retrofits, and modular deployments.
  • Establish structural requirements, reference design approaches, technical standards, and design guardrails that can be applied across data center platforms and multiple jurisdictions.
  • Design structural systems optimized for prefabricated and modular construction, including modular skids, precast components, factory-built PODs, and off-site assembled MEP yards.
  • Incorporate requirements for off-site manufacturing, transportation, lifting, rigging, installation, tolerances, and interfaces between factory-built modules and site-built infrastructure.
  • Review and perform load analyses for raised floors, equipment racks, generators, cooling infrastructure, and rooftop or ground-mounted mechanical equipment.
  • Set technical direction for seismic, wind, and building-code compliance strategies across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate with architectural, civil, MEP, manufacturing, and fabrication partners to integrate structural designs into prefabricated delivery workflows.
  • Lead structural design reviews, shop drawing reviews, constructability assessments, and the resolution of complex structural interface issues.
  • Review fabricator calculations, shop drawings, and submittals, resolving tolerance and interface challenges between prefabricated modules and site-built structures.
  • Lead constructability and value-engineering reviews focused on modular sequencing, transportation logistics, installation constraints, safety, reliability, and speed-to-market.
  • Evaluate existing facilities and develop practical structural solutions for upgrades supporting increased power and cooling density.
  • Partner with Product Engineering, construction, manufacturing, and regional delivery teams to improve cross-functional alignment and technical execution.
  • Mentor engineers, elevate structural design quality, and establish disciplined review practices for calculations, design packages, and technical decisions.
  • Conduct site visits, construction observations, and visits to fabrication and off-site manufacturing facilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Engineer license required.
  • 10 or more years of structural engineering experience.
  • At least four years of structural engineering experience supporting data centers or other mission-critical facilities.
  • Hands-on experience designing structural systems for modular or prefabricated construction.
  • Demonstrated experience designing foundations, steel and concrete framing, floor systems, and equipment support structures.
  • Experience with foundations supporting heavy equipment with varying vibration, movement, and operational requirements.
  • Experience managing structural requirements associated with the transportation, lifting, and rigging of prefabricated modules.
  • Deep working knowledge of ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC, IBC, and other applicable structural design standards and building codes.
  • Proficiency with structural analysis and design software such as ETABS, SAP2000, RISA, or RAM.
  • Strong knowledge of seismic and wind design requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience reviewing structural calculations, design packages, fabricator shop drawings, technical submittals, and construction documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical decisions and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, technical problem-solving, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, priorities, and technical workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel for construction observations, site visits, and visits to fabrication facilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Structural Engineer license, particularly for work within high-seismic markets.
  • Direct experience partnering with modular fabricators or off-site manufacturing facilities.
  • Experience leading structural design across multiple concurrent hyperscale or colocation data center projects.
  • Revit and BIM coordination experience, including clash detection across prefabricated and site-built interfaces.
  • Experience coordinating structural systems that support physical security, equipment movement, move-in and move-out requirements, prefabrication, and other trades.
  • Experience developing repeatable structural standards and reference designs for use across multiple projects or global platforms.
  • Experience supporting retrofit projects and infrastructure upgrades within operating mission-critical facilities.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $170,000- $175,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)
  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.
  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

raw.description:
VetsEZ is currently looking for a VistA/MUMPS Developer for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support a Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) initiative focused on reducing and ultimately eliminating the use of Social Security Numbers (SSNs) within critical VistA applications, workflows, reports, audit records, and related processes. The developer will analyze existing VistA functionality, implement MUMPS/M software modifications, troubleshoot defects, and support the transition from SSN-based processes toward approved enterprise identifiers while reducing exposure of sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

This position will work within a remote, multidisciplinary Agile development team alongside Lead VistA Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Quality Assurance personnel, cybersecurity teams, and Government stakeholders. Development activities will support multiple VistA packages, including Admission, Discharge, Transfer (ADT), Patient Care Encounter (PCE), Automated Information Collection System (AICS), Record Tracking, and VistA Audit Solutions.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities:

  • Modify and enhance VistA/MUMPS applications to eliminate or replace SSN usage within business processes, user interfaces, reports, audit trails, and related functionality while implementing approved approaches for transitioning to enterprise identifiers.
  • Analyze existing VistA routines, data structures, workflows, and application dependencies to identify affected functionality, troubleshoot defects, and implement secure, maintainable code consistent with VA and project development standards.
  • Develop and execute unit tests and support functional, integration, regression, User Acceptance Testing, deployment validation, and production-readiness activities to ensure modifications preserve existing functionality and meet approved requirements.
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance personnel to investigate defects, implement corrections, verify resolutions, and support post-release troubleshooting and application stability.
  • Follow secure software development and sensitive-data-handling practices when working with PII and PHI, support applicable VA privacy, security, and NIST control requirements, and produce technical documentation describing application changes and implementation considerations.
  • Collaborate with Lead Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, QA personnel, cybersecurity teams, and other stakeholders within an Agile environment, participating in Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives while communicating estimates, technical issues, dependencies, and risks.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience, with 5+ years of professional VistA/MUMPS development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience programming within VistA using MUMPS/M and InterSystems Caché, GT.M, or a comparable M-based platform.
  • Experience modifying or supporting VistA packages, modules, data structures, or other healthcare information systems, including analysis of existing routines, workflows, and application dependencies.
  • Experience with software debugging and troubleshooting, source control, peer code review, unit and integration testing, and Agile software development practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an understanding of secure software development practices and the ability to accurately troubleshoot complex application issues.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary software development team and communicate technical issues, dependencies, and risks.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) VistA environments, particularly ADT, PCE, AICS, Record Tracking, VistA Audit Solutions, or related VistA packages.
  • Familiarity with PII/PHI protection, healthcare data privacy requirements, and applicable NIST security controls, HIPAA, FISMA, or VA security requirements.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum development teams supporting federal healthcare modernization, application remediation, or complex enterprise healthcare environments.

Security Clearance Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

Join Our Team at Duncan Solutions, LLC

Duncan Solutions, LLC, is a full-service transportation management company that focuses on connecting people, technology, and data to make cities more livable and efficient. As a leading provider of parking and tolling management solutions, we support municipal and commercial clients with citation processing, debt collection, DMV registered owner identification, back-office transaction processing, image review, customer service center and customer experience (CX) operations, integrated on-street parking management, and more.

WORK LOCATION

This is a remote position with eligibility in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KS, LA, MD, MA, MI, MO, MN, NJ, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, WV, D.C. Candidates must reside in one of the following locations for consideration.

Please note: Duncan Solutions, LLC, does not provide visa sponsorship now or in the future. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship requirements.

PAY TRANSPARANCY

This role will offer $85,000 - $100,000 annually, depending on experience, skills, and location.

WORKING HOURS

Monday–Friday schedule aligned to business hours, with participation in after-hours, weekends, or on-call support rotations as needed. 

POSITION SUMMARY

The IT Solutions Analyst – Cybersecurity is responsible for supporting the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of security operations and engineering capabilities across the organization. This role serves as a technical contributor and analytical resource within the Cyber Team, supporting security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and the engineering of security controls and tooling. The Analyst works closely with the CISO and Cyber Team to identify security gaps, operationalize threat intelligence, and ensure that security solutions align with organizational risk tolerance, compliance requirements, and operational standards.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Triage and respond to Tier 1 & Tier 2 security incidents and alerts, including initial investigation, containment actions, and escalation in accordance with the incident response process
  • Monitor security event queues, analyze alerts from SIEM and other security tooling, and document findings and resolutions to support shared knowledge and continuous improvement within the Cyber Team
  • Analyze existing security systems, architectures, and data flows to identify vulnerabilities, coverage gaps, or improve detection, response, or operational efficiency
  • Translate business requirements into documentation, detailed functional specifications, process flows, and user stories
  • Assist in developing, executing, and supporting security validation and testing activities
  • Analyze trends in security events, alerts, and incidents to identify emerging threat patterns, detection gaps, or operational improvement opportunities
  • Document system behavior, requirements, test results, and process changes
  • Assist with security incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and post-incident review to drive improvements in detection and response capabilities
  • Ensure security operations and engineering activities align with applicable compliance requirements, security frameworks (NIST 800-53, PCI-DSS) and internal policies and standards

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Hands-on experience with security tools (SWG, CASB, ZTNA, Cloud SIEM, EDR/XDR, DLP)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Understanding of encryption, authentication, and secure protocols
  • Experience supporting security control testing, or penetration testing activities

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE / SKILLS

  • High School Diploma or GED from an accredited institution
  • 2-3 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, IT security analysis, or a related security role

PREFERRED

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards (NIST 800-53, STIGs)
  • Experience with AWS cloud security
  • Basic experience with query languages or scripting (KQL, SPL, SQL, Python)
  • Industry-recognized security certifications (GSEC, Security+, CySA+, SSCP)

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

  • This role is primarily computer-based and may be performed in an office or remote work environment. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WHAT WE OFFER

Duncan Solutions, LLC, offers a professional environment, stability, upward mobility, and a wide breadth of benefits. We offer our full-time regular employees who meet eligibility criteria the following which include:

Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • Healthcare & Dependent Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

Paid Time Off

Other Voluntary Benefits

This position requires the ability to obtain a government security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required. Selected applicants will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

The role includes building highly scalable backend services capable of processing large volumes of routing decisions with strict latency, availability, and resiliency requirements. You will work primarily with Java, Spring Boot, distributed architectures, event-driven systems, and cloud-native technologies, collaborating closely with product, architecture, workforce management, telephony, and CX platform teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop enterprise-scale routing engines that distribute voice and digital interactions in real time.
  • Implement intelligent routing algorithms based on skills, priorities, capacity, availability, and business rules.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, resilience, and performance across queues, routing paths, and interaction workloads.
  • Design and maintain APIs supporting routing configuration, administration, monitoring, and integration requirements.
  • Optimize systems for high concurrency, fault tolerance, resiliency, and predictable performance.
  • Integrate routing services with telephony, digital messaging, workforce management, CRM, identity, reporting, and analytics platforms.
  • Design and develop critical Java and Spring Boot services, APIs, integration components, and reference implementations.
  • Translate business journeys and operational requirements into solution components, interaction flows, deployment views, and technical roadmaps.
  • Define non-functional requirements for availability, performance, concurrency, security, privacy, observability, disaster recovery, and supportability.
  • Review designs and code, identify technical risks, challenge assumptions, and drive pragmatic decisions that balance quality, time, and cost.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, quality gates, documentation expectations, and technology adoption guidance.
  • Collaborate with CX domain experts to translate operational requirements into routing capabilities.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of architecture and technical delivery for distributed applications.
  • Expert-level hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, implementing distributed systems and microservices architectures, REST APIs, persistence, security, testing, and performance engineering.
  • Experience developing routing logic for contact center, communications, or customer engagement platforms.
  • Knowledge of ACD concepts, agent states, queue management, skill-based routing, priority routing, proficiency routing, and workload balancing.
  • Experience building high-throughput, low-latency transaction processing systems.Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven architecture, messaging, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases, data modeling, integration data flows, and transactional design.
  • Hands-on experience with contact center or CX platforms and the operational concepts behind customer routing and engagement.

We are seeking a Front-End Developer to support a United States Air Force (USAF) program focused on delivering modern, secure, and accessible web applications for mission-critical cybersecurity and vulnerability management platforms. The developer will play a key role in building and enhancing user interfaces across multiple front-end frameworks, integrating data from enterprise systems, and ensuring compliance with federal security and accessibility standards.   • Implement OIDC-based authentication and secure token management.
  • Apply front-end security best practices, including CSP and XSS prevention.
  • Ensure compliance with Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
  • Develop unit and component tests and support automated UI testing efforts.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, Git workflows, and CI/CD processes.

Required Skills:
  • Must possess an active Secret Clearance
  • 0-3 years of professional front-end development experience.

  • Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs using Axios or Fetch.
  • Experience writing unit tests using Vitest, Jest, or similar testing frameworks.
  • Proficiency with Git version control and GitLab merge request workflows.
  • Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, and front-end development best practices.

Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with Vite for modern front-end development and build optimization.
  • Experience with Cypress for end-to-end and component testing of web applications.
  • Knowledge of data visualization tools and libraries, including D3.js and other charting frameworks.
  • Understanding of front-end security best practices, including Content Security Policy (CSP) and secure web application development.
  • Familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG accessibility standards to ensure compliance and inclusive user experiences.
  • Experience using Docker for local development, testing, and containerized application environments.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification or willingness to obtain it to meet DoD 8140 compliance requirements.
  • Prior experience supporting DoD, USAF, or Federal Government programs.

raw.description:
NovaKid is a global leader in online English education for children aged 4–12, serving 100000+ students across 50+ countries. As the Product Manager for AI & Game-Based Learning, you will own the "non-live" student experience.

Your goal is to transform the Novakid Kid’s Area from a supplementary area into a significant driver of language acquisition for young kids. You will lead the development of self-guided English learning games and integrate cutting-edge AI-based self-practice tools that encourage children to speak more, practice safely, and stay motivated between their 1:1 teacher sessions.

Focus: Kid’s Area, Self-Learning Games, and AI Features

What you’ll do

  • Lead a small team of designers and developers (with access to analytical and research resources).

  • Design and scale features like Pandy AI Tutor to provide 24/7, judgment-free speaking practice for students across various proficiencies.

  • Own the roadmap for current and future gamified worlds, focusing on LLM based learning mini-games that reinforce curriculum-aligned vocabulary and grammar.

  • Use AI to create adaptive learning paths that adjust game difficulty and content in real-time based on a child’s performance in both live classes and self-study.

  • Work with engineering to refine Speech-to-Text and AI prompting logic to maximize student speaking time—aiming for the high-engagement levels seen in AI-only learning models.

  • Design and manage the "Economy of Fun," including avatars, star rewards, and other gamification features that compete for a child's attention against mainstream apps.

  • Work closely with designers, engineers, curriculum developers, and teacher operations to turn user insights into high-quality educational content and engaging UX.

Requirements

What you’ll have

  • 4+ years’ experience in a PM role.

  • Hands-on experience in AI-powered features (prompt engineering, conversational AI, or adaptive algorithms).

  • Strong background in mobile gaming or highly gamified EdTech, with a deep understanding of reward systems, level progression, and retention hooks.

  • Proven ability to build interfaces for 4–12-year-olds that are intuitive, safe, and require zero parental intervention.

  • Proficiency in analytical tools to analyze "incidental learning" metrics and game-completion rates.

  • Manage the Agile process with our engineering team, ensuring that prototypes are delivered and scaled with technical excellence.

  • You thrive in a 100% remote, distributed team environment and are a master of tools like JIRA and Slack.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.

What we offer

  • Fully remote work (core hours GMT+3).

  • A chance to shape the future of AI-driven education.

  • A fun, dynamic team that loves building innovative products.Unlimited holidays – because we trust you to deliver.

  • Bonuses and stock options – we grow together.

About the Role

Join a world-class academic healthcare organization as a Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Developer within the Information Security department. This is a fully remote opportunity and may be based outside of the greater Chicagoland area.

In this role, the Senior IAM Developer will take an active role in developing departmental policies and procedures as they relate to program usage. This position involves developing user manuals, participating in user demonstrations and focus groups, and maintaining up-to-date technical knowledge through various information sources.

Under the direction of IAM leadership, the Senior IAM Developer provides technical expertise, develops standards, guidelines, and processes for application systems, and translates business requirements into well-designed applicationsbalancing user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints.

This role also involves reviewing system designs and code development for key architectural components, contributing to infrastructure and technology decisions, and participating in regional and national IAM communities to share and expand knowledge.

The Senior IAM Developer will also formulate and define specifications for complex IAM installations, maintenance, and upgrades, while identifying and analyzing performance and capacity issues. The position leads installation and maintenance of major operating system components, multiple program products, and ancillary system components; serves as a technical authority on multiple operating system elements; and collaborates with users, analysts, and technical staff to resolve system issues.

Requirements

  • Essential Job Functions

    • Architect, design, and develop IAM technical solutions that meet business needs.

    • Evaluate capacity and performance issues.

    • Document technical solutions including specifications, models, diagrams, and other documentation as requested or required.

    • Support production applications and environments 24/7.

    • Effectively collaborate with IAM team members to ensure quality and delivery of solutions.

    • Review and provide feedback on business requirements and proposed technical solutions.

    • Participate in regional and national IAM communities to expand and share knowledge while improving practices.

    • Brainstorm with team members to identify alternative solutions.

    • Serve as a technical expert for the IAM team.

    • Perform additional duties as assigned.

    Required Qualifications

    • BS or BA degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent education, training, or work experience (Master's degree preferred).

    • 5 years of experience as an IAM developer or engineer.

    • 3 years of hands-on SailPoint experience.

    • 3 years of hands-on CyberArk experience.

    • 5 or more years of programming experience developing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining applications with any of the following languages:

      • Java, Java EE

      • JavaScript, HTML, and CSS

      • SQL and Transact-SQL

      • Perl, PHP, Python, or Ruby

      • XML and JSON

    • Expert knowledge and multiple years of experience across:

      • Programming within UNIX/Linux using Unix Shell (bash)

      • Database systems such as MySQL, SQL Server, NoSQL, and Oracle

      • Programming LDAP using APIs such as OpenLDAP, JNDI, or Netscape

      • Web-service technologies such as SOAP or REST

      • Single Sign-On technologies (Shibboleth, OpenID Connect)

      • Open-source software and collaboration on open-source projects

      • Network authentication tools such as RADIUS or TACACS

      • Microsoft Active Directory

      • Version control software

    • 2 or more years working with IAM systems and technologies such as Azure, Okta, OneLogin, Oracle Identity Manager, or similar.

    • Prior experience mentoring junior team members.

    • Experience with HIPAA, NIST, FERPA, and SOX standards preferred.

Job Summary:

The Program Manager owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of strategic customer programs at Elovate. You'll ensure programs are delivered on time, meet defined outcomes, and create measurable value for both customers and the business.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The Program Manager owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of strategic customer programs at Elovate. This role requires a strong program management mindset — driving structure, alignment, and delivery — while also serving as a trusted partner to our municipal and agency customers. You'll ensure programs are delivered on time, meet defined outcomes, and create measurable value for both customers and the business.

Responsibilities

Program Planning & Delivery

  • Lead the planning and execution of customer programs, ensuring milestones, deliverables, and outcomes are consistently met.
  • Translate customer objectives into structured program roadmaps with clear success criteria, timelines, and ownership.
  • Manage program governance including progress tracking, status reporting, risk management, and escalation handling.
  • Coordinate program kickoffs, milestone reviews, and closeout activities.
  • Maintain thorough program documentation — plans, RAID logs, decision records.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, building strong, trust-based relationships.
  • Ensure ongoing alignment between customer goals and Elovate's solutions and service delivery.
  • Provide customers with regular program reviews, data-driven performance insights, and strategic recommendations.
  • Proactively identify and address customer concerns before they become escalations.
  • Partner with customers on program expansions, renewals, and long-term roadmap planning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Facilitate collaboration across Product, Operations, Field Service, and leadership to drive successful program delivery.
  • Coordinate internal resources and manage competing priorities to meet customer commitments.
  • Champion the customer voice internally to influence product improvements and service enhancements.
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success leadership on account strategy and growth opportunities.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Define program success metrics and KPIs; track and report on outcomes against targets.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve processes and strengthen customer partnerships.
  • Conduct post-program reviews to capture lessons learned.
  • Contribute to scalable program management frameworks, templates, and best practices.
  • Analyze program data to surface trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

  • Develop and deliver clear, concise program status updates tailored to both operational and executive audiences.
  • Maintain a regular cadence of customer and internal communications.
  • Prepare program reviews, executive briefings, and customer-facing reports that demonstrate program value and impact.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in program or project management, customer success, consulting, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives from concept through completion.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills with experience engaging senior stakeholders.
  • Proven track record of building and maintaining strong customer relationships.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to define metrics, measure progress, and report outcomes.

Nice to Haves

  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification.
  • Experience working with municipal or government agency customers.
  • Background in automated traffic enforcement, public safety technology, or SaaS/hardware service delivery.
  • Familiarity with program management tools such as Smartsheet, Asana, or Monday.com.
  • Experience with contract management and SLA oversight.

AI & Technology

Elovate encourages Program Managers to leverage AI tools to work more efficiently, communicate more effectively, and deliver greater value to customers.

  • Use AI-assisted tools to streamline program documentation — status reports, RAID logs, executive summaries, and customer-facing communications.
  • Leverage AI analytics to monitor program health, identify schedule risks early, and surface data-driven insights for customer reviews.
  • Apply AI tools to synthesize customer feedback, meeting notes, and program data into actionable recommendations and lessons learned.
  • Stay current on AI tools relevant to program management and customer success, bringing relevant capabilities to your workflows.
  • Apply sound judgment when using AI-generated outputs — validating all customer-facing content before delivery.

About Elovate

Elovate, a Modaxo company, has been a trusted partner to municipalities and state agencies for over 30 years. We deliver data-driven automated traffic enforcement solutions — covering speed, red light, school zone, and work zone safety — designed to prevent dangerous driving behaviors before they lead to incidents. Our mission is simple: protect lives and create safer roads for the communities we serve. As part of Modaxo, a global collective of people-movement technology companies, we combine deep industry expertise with innovative technology to make meaningful, lasting impact.

raw.description:
NovaKid is a global leader in online English education for children aged 4–12, serving 100000+ students across 50+ countries. As the Product Manager for AI & Game-Based Learning, you will own the "non-live" student experience.

Your goal is to transform the Novakid Kid’s Area from a supplementary area into a significant driver of language acquisition for young kids. You will lead the development of self-guided English learning games and integrate cutting-edge AI-based self-practice tools that encourage children to speak more, practice safely, and stay motivated between their 1:1 teacher sessions.

Focus: Kid’s Area, Self-Learning Games, and AI Features

What you’ll do

  • Lead a small team of designers and developers (with access to analytical and research resources).

  • Design and scale features like Pandy AI Tutor to provide 24/7, judgment-free speaking practice for students across various proficiencies.

  • Own the roadmap for current and future gamified worlds, focusing on LLM based learning mini-games that reinforce curriculum-aligned vocabulary and grammar.

  • Use AI to create adaptive learning paths that adjust game difficulty and content in real-time based on a child’s performance in both live classes and self-study.

  • Work with engineering to refine Speech-to-Text and AI prompting logic to maximize student speaking time—aiming for the high-engagement levels seen in AI-only learning models.

  • Design and manage the "Economy of Fun," including avatars, star rewards, and other gamification features that compete for a child's attention against mainstream apps.

  • Work closely with designers, engineers, curriculum developers, and teacher operations to turn user insights into high-quality educational content and engaging UX.

Requirements

What you’ll have

  • 4+ years’ experience in a PM role.

Bold

Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Estamos creando soluciones de pago y de banca para MiPymes, independientes y emprendedores en Colombia. Actualmente contamos con más de 600.000 clientes registrados en nuestra plataforma y hemos recibido más de USD $120 millones de fondos de inversión nacionales y extranjeros, somos una de las startups de más rápido crecimiento en LatAm en el sector fintech.

Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor.
Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos.

En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos.

Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web:

El Rol

En Bold, transformamos la manera en que los comercios reciben pagos a través de la tecnología. Como Líder de Fraude Interno, serás el guardián de nuestra cultura de ética y transparencia. Tu misión principal será fortalecer el ambiente de control interno de la compañía mediante el diseño, implementación y evolución del programa de prevención, detección e investigación de fraude interno. A través de un enfoque proactivo y técnico, asegurarás que Bold cuente con controles robustos que evite el fraude y mitigue los riesgos asociados.

Deberás

  • Identificar vulnerabilidades en los procesos internos de Bold, proponer controles, mitigar el riesgo de malas prácticas por parte de colaboradores o terceros aliados.

  • Ampliar, administrar y promover el uso de los canales de denuncia.

  • Conducir Investigaciones forenses, recopilar evidencias digital/documental, entrevistas, emitir informes técnicos y forenses.

  • Proponer planes de acción y remediación, para cerrar brechas de control y evitar la recurrencia de los eventos.

  • Promover la cultura y capacitación, sensibilización y entrenamientos para los colaboradores.

  • Presentar informes periódicos e indicadores, participar en comités de ética, auditoría/riesgos.

¿Qué tenemos para ti?

🤝 Contrato a término indefinido

💲 Salario competitivo

💻 Trabajo remoto tiempo completo

👨🏽‍⚕️ Póliza de salud

📚 Apoyo económico para educación

🌎 Tecnologías y procesos de clase mundial

🏖️ Días libres adicionales a las vacaciones

👓 Bono para salud visual

❤️‍🩹Bienestar emocional

Requirements

  • Profesional graduado en áreas como contaduría pública, administración de empresas, ingeniería industrial, derecho, economía o carreras afines.

  • Deseable especialización o maestría en auditoría forense, gestión de riesgos, control interno, derecho penal o afines.

  • Certificaciones Plus: CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CIA (Certified Internal Auditor) o similares.

  • 3 años de experiencia previa en roles de auditoría interna/forense, gestión de fraude, investigaciones corporativas o cumplimiento (Compliance).

  • Sólidos conocimientos en metodologías de investigación forense y cadena de custodia.

  • Comprensión de marcos de control interno (ej. COSO).

  • Manejo de herramientas de análisis de datos (SQL, Excel avanzado, Power BI) para la detección de anomalías o patrones inusuales (muy deseable en el entorno Fintech).

En Bold, el talento no tiene etiquetas. Fomentamos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y accesible para todos, garantizando un proceso de selección equitativo. Si necesitas algún ajuste razonable para participar en el proceso, por favor infórmanos al postularte.

Autorización de Tratamiento de Datos Personales

Al realizar la postulación y brindar tus datos personales, en cumplimiento a la normatividad vigente de protección de datos personales, autorizas de forma inequívoca y voluntaria el tratamiento de tus datos personales, de acuerdo con las finalidades contenidas en la Política de Tratamiento de Datos Personales de las Compañías Bold, disponibles en su pagina web y .
Como Titular de Datos Personales, te asisten los derechos previstos en la Ley 1581 de 2012 y demás normas que la complementen o modifiquen, en especial, los derechos a conocer, actualizar, rectificar o solicitar la supresión de tus datos, y revocar la autorización que has otorgado para el uso de tus Datos Personales.
