• Are you skilled in professional video production, ready to create high-quality content that stands out?

  • Do you excel at storytelling, always uncovering fresh ideas and unique angles that drive views and engagement?

  • Are you passionate about empowering WordPress website creators, using your video expertise to guide them on their journey?

If you're excited about the idea of using video to communicate powerful messages, build brand presence, and support WordPress creators, then you might be the perfect fit for our team. 🤩

We're seeking a creative individual who excels in both video production and innovative idea generation for both long and short videos, to join us as our Video Content Creator for our three products: WP Rocket,Imagify, and RocketCDN. 🚀

Keep reading for more details! 📝

Become Our New Video Content Creator!

As a Video Content Creator, your role will be to create compelling video content that aligns with our marketing strategies, helping to attract and engage with our target audiences.

Your video content will be key to making our brands shine and enhancing the performance of our marketing efforts.

In this role, you'll report to the Head of Marketing and become an integral part of our marketing team. We work remotely and are excited to see which new location will join our global team map! 🌍

What You Will Be Doing

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Researching current trends and audience preferences to inform your video content creation.

  • Developing and maintaining a cohesive brand voice and visual style across all video content.

  • Crafting and executing a video content strategy for WP Rocket, Imagify, and RocketCDN, tailored to each platform.

  • Recording yourself discussing technical topics related to web-performance and WordPress

  • Producing, editing, and sharing engaging video posts regularly and responding to user interactions.

  • Conceiving and producing video ads with strong hooks and visuals designed to capture attention fast and drive measurable results (clicks, sign-ups, conversions).

  • Testing different hooks, formats, and creative angles for paid campaigns, and iterating based on performance data.

  • Collaborating with the marketing team to ensure your video content supports our campaigns and brand goals.

  • Tracking the performance of your video content, analyzing metrics, and making data-driven decisions to refine and improve your strategy.

What Do You Need To Excel at This Job

  • Storytelling skills - You have a knack for crafting compelling narratives through visual media, effectively communicating messages that captivate and engage your audience. You're attentive to detail and committed to creating exceptional viewer experiences.

  • Video editing skills - You're skilled in the technical aspects of video production, including sound, lighting, and the use of post-production tools. Your expertise ensures that every piece of content is polished and professionally presented, enhancing the overall storytelling experience.

  • WordPress Knowledge and/or Taste for Technical Products - You have a solid understanding of WordPress or a genuine interest in technical products, with the ability to translate complex technical features into engaging video content.

  • Excellent proficiency in English - Your English is absolutely perfect. You write with excellent spelling, grammar, and proofreading skills, while remaining accessible to a non-native English-speaking audience.

  • Proven working experience in video marketing - You have experience with social media marketing, particularly in creating video content that resonates on platforms like YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.

  • Organizational skills- You can juggle different tasks but also know when to ask for help. The team will always be at your side to support you in case of doubt, but relies on you to deliver on time for seamless collaboration.

About us

Founded in 2014 in the beautiful Lyon, France, WP Media is an equal opportunity employer with a distributed team of +45 teammates living around the world.
WP Media is the French company behind successful WordPress plugins like WP Rocket and Imagify. WP Rocket is the premium caching plugin for WordPress used by +5,000,000 websites worldwide. Our plugin makes sites go at the speed of light in just a few clicks. Imagify is our free image optimization service, including a free WordPress plugin: we have already optimized more than 19,000,000,000 images! 😲

You will join our remote, global Marketing team and collaborate with talented teammates across multiple countries and time zones. We have flexible working hours & a remote work culture. We value clear communication and encourage everyone to participate actively. We are eager to find out which new country will be added to our distributed team map! 🌍

WP Media is part of group.One, a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting and digital marketing services.

group.oneis a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1 500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint.


Do We Share the Same Values?

Mutual respect, collaboration, and inclusivity.

These are the fundamental values that support our life as a team.

Healthy balance between work and private life.

We encourage our employees to enjoy their family and hobbies with flexible working hours and minimum vacation policy. There are no time cards to stamp, only customers to make happy and friendly teammates to work with! We care about the work you do, not about the hours you sit at your desk.

We like to see each other in person whenever possible.

Every year, we organize a trip with the whole team and spend a week of coworking and fun activities together.

To give you an idea, so far we have traveled to Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Greece and Serbia.

We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment.

We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here—what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member.

We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you.

Now that we've told you so much about us, it's your turn.

Let us know why you would like to become our Video Content Creator and why you think you are the person we are looking for.

We can’t wait to receive your application! 🌟

AtFoxelli Group, we're not just leading the digital marketplace - we're redefining it. With 10 years of experience and a portfolio of thriving direct-to-consumer (D2C) brands generating over $20 million USD annually, we’re pushing boundaries to achieve our next growth milestone.

That’s why we’re on the hunt for the Community Growth & Sales Specialist who’s ready to make a real impact.

❕This role is 100% remote and you will join a team that already works from 20 different world countries.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a strategic, analytical, and entrepreneurial mind to turn online communities—especially Facebook groups—into revenue-generating powerhouses. You’ll drive engagement, build relationships, and convert active audiences into customers.

If you love solving complex puzzles, spotting untapped opportunities, and figuring things out independently, this might be your dream job.

This isn’t a role for someone who waits for instructions. We need a problem solver who thrives on challenges, loves puzzles, and finds creative ways to drive sales without relying on traditional marketing channels.

You’ll have access to a high-level, premium training program to master community-based sales strategies, but ultimately, we expect you to take ownership, experiment, and make things happen.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identify, infiltrate, and engage with high-potential community groups (mainly on Facebook) to drive sales.

  • Craft compelling, high-converting posts and discussions that don’t feel like sales pitches.

  • Create visuals and copy that grab attention and build trust.

  • Solve problems on the spot—whether it’s engagement drops, algorithm shifts, or content flops.

  • Run experiments and track data to constantly optimize your approach.

  • Own the entire sales pipeline from community interactions to conversions—no micromanagement, just results.

Requirements

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Analytical & Strategic – You see patterns, connect the dots, and solve complex problems like a pro.

  • Entrepreneurial & Self-Sufficient – You don’t ask for solutions; you find them.

  • Geeky & Tech-Savvy – You love testing new tools, staying ahead of trends, and understanding platforms inside out.

  • Creative & Persuasive – You know how to craft content that sells without being "salesy."

  • Data-Driven & Adaptive – You test, tweak, and iterate to optimize performance.

IDEAL BACKGROUND

  • Experience in e-commerce, tech, or digital marketing.

  • Strong copywriting & content creation skills.

  • Ability to design simple yet effective visuals for posts.

  • Track record of driving sales through online communities (especially Facebook).

  • Deep understanding of social media algorithms and engagement tactics.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • 10 min online DISC assessment to identify your behavioral style, as we strongly believe in the power of diverse teams.

  • 15-30 min intro e-meet with Foxelli Group Talent Acquisition team to discuss company, role, your experiences, and expectations.

  • Home Task.

  • 60 min e-meet with the Hiring Manager and Foxelli Group CPO to discuss the vision of the role, your competencies, and technical skills, followed by a two-way Q&A session.

  • Decision & Feedback from us.

SALARY

€1100 - €2000 after taxes (depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience) with the potential for quarterly performance-based bonuses tied to KPIs.

❕Please note that this role requires a self-employment certificate.

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and keeping your physical well-being in check.

  • A personal development budget is at your disposal for yourpersonal and professional growth to ensure you keep continuously growing.

  • Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.

  • A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.

  • Strong company cultureand a network of unique individuals that celebrates you.

  • Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting for your control of a working day, powered by Hubstaff for transparency and fairness.

ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

At Foxelli Group, our team operates primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET), which is UTC+2 and UTC+3. We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

Currently, we are hiring in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

IMPACT BRANDS has already positively impacted the lives of 3 million people worldwide. Join us as a remote Head of Accounting and let’s impact billions together!

We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to lead and develop our accounting operations across both e-commerce and manufacturing divisions. In this role, you will be responsible for leading and managing all core accounting processes, including month-end close, the preparation of annual financial statements, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, vendor and payment management, invoice approval, internal controls, and fraud prevention. The role requires IFRS or U.S. GAAP expertise, an international accounting background, and the ability to design and implement scalable financial operations and policies.

  • Home office budget. A home office allowance and the possibility to choose between a MacBook or a Windows-based workstation.

Bits of your job:

  • Oversee accounting operations across a group of e-commerce companies and a separate manufacturing entity.

  • Design and implement robust processes for AR, AP, payment management, vendor management, invoice approval, and scam/fraud prevention.

  • Develop accounting policies and internal control procedures in compliance with U.S. GAAP standards.

  • Manage month-end and year-end closing, financial statements accuracy, and internal/external audits.

  • Evaluate, propose, and implement accounting systems, tools, and automation solutions to improve efficiency and accuracy.

  • Lead, train, and support the accounting team to ensure alignment and effectiveness across processes and platforms.

  • Collaborate with finance, operations, and management to ensure timely and consistent financial reporting.

  • Monitor cash flow, reconcile accounts, and ensure compliance with local and international accounting regulations.

  • Act as a key point of contact for banks, auditors, and other external stakeholders.

  • And other tasks.

Requirements

Key expectations:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA or equivalent qualification preferred.

  • 8+ years of accounting leadership experience, ideally across both e-commerce and manufacturing sectors.

  • Proven experience with IFRS or U.S. GAAP accounting standards.

  • Strong knowledge of accounting operations including AR/AP, payments, vendor management, invoice approvals and audit procedures.

  • Experience creating and implementing accounting policies, controls, and process improvement initiatives.

  • Demonstrated history of preventing and managing financial fraud or vendor-related scams.

  • Proficiency in ERP or accounting systems (e.g. QuickBooks or similar).

  • Strong leadership and communication skills with ability to mentor and guide accounting teams.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented with an analytical mindset.

Key skills:

  • U.S. GAAP or IFRS accounting standards

  • Internal controls and risk management

  • Vendor and payment process design

  • Financial system implementation and integration

  • Fraud prevention and audit coordination

  • Team training and leadership

You’ll combine technical and functional expertise to design and implement solutions across domains such as Supply Chain, Finance, and HR. With your vision and leadership, you ensure seamless integration and maximum value for our clients.

Do you have the knowledge, experience, and drive to support companies in their digital transformation? Join our team and make an impact!

About the role:

As a SAP Functional Solution Architect you play a crucial role in selling, designing, and implementing complex SAP solutions deployed worldwide to optimize business processes. You analyze organizational needs and translate them into scalable SAP architectures that integrate various modules such as SuccessFactors Employee Central, Employee Central Payroll, and SuccessFactors Time Tracking. You also coordinate with international teams, ensure seamless system integration, and make sure the solutions meet both technical and business objectives.

You’ll coordinate with sales and presales colleagues to determine the best solutions for clients and how to achieve them. You play a key role in designing technical architectures that improve business processes and add value.

You stay up to date with the latest technologies like SAP Payroll and cloud solutions and influence global strategies. This role combines leadership, technical innovation, and international collaboration in an inspiring environment.

  • Experience in monitoring and managing SAP Payroll systems to ensure efficiency and compliance.

  • Proven experience in improving and automating processes within an SAP environment.

  • Strong ability to manage changes and updates in the system while minimizing their impact on processes.

Location: Bethesda, MD (hybrid or remote available).

Salary range: $120,000 - $165,000

GRF CPAS & Advisors has been part of the Washington, DC metropolitan region since 1981. The firm provides outsourced accounting, auditing, risk advisory and consulting, and tax services to an extensive client base, which consists of nonprofit organizations, government contractors, professional service firms and others.

Looking for Manager/Senior Controller role at an energetic & passionate company? GRF CPAS & Advisors, a Bethesda, MD CPA Firm is in search of a Supervisor/Controller join our Outsourced Accounting and Advisory Services team. This position is fully remote although persons local to the DMV area are welcomed to come to the office at any time.

The OAAS Manager plays a pivotal role in the Outsourced Accounting and Advisory Services (OAAS) practice by overseeing day-to-day accounting operations, supervising staff, and delivering high-quality, audit-ready financial reporting for a portfolio of nonprofit and/or government contractor clients. This position ensures client engagements are executed smoothly and efficiently, serving as a bridge between the engagement team and senior leadership. Managers are expected to proactively build and strengthen client relationships - serving as trusted advisors who understand client goals, anticipate needs, and contribute insights - while managing deliverables, budgets, and team development in support of firm growth and culture.

Essential Functions:

  1. Oversee daily accounting operations and deliverables for a portfolio of nonprofit and/or government contractor clients.
  2. Ensure timely and accurate monthly close processes, financial reporting, and compliance requirements (e.g., grant and contract compliance, etc.).
  3. Serve as the primary point of contact for ongoing client communications; maintain regular touchpoints to foster trust and address evolving needs.
  4. Support client onboarding by establishing workflows, timelines, and expectations; coordinate with clients and internal teams to ensure a smooth transition.
  5. Regularly present financial results and key insights to client management and leadership teams.
  6. Plan, schedule, and staff engagements using firm policies and procedures; delegate effectively to promote staff development and operate at highest and best use.
  7. Monitor engagement budgets, time budgets, and resource utilization; assist with billing and contribute to realization and utilization goals for assigned clients.
  8. Identify opportunities to add value through process improvements, automation, and advisory insights; begin developing awareness of client service expansion opportunities.
  9. Review and evaluate internal controls and work programs prepared by staff; provide real-time coaching, training, and feedback, including explaining reasoning behind corrections.
  10. Supervise and review work of Staff and Senior Accountants and mentor Supervisors as needed; actively participate in the department coaching program as a coach to assigned team members.
  11. Ensure that client financial statements and supporting schedules are prepared in accordance with GAAP, applicable regulations, and firm standards; proactively identify GAAP implications in client transactions.
  12. Anticipate problem areas and questions that may arise; keep partner/leadership informed of significant developments, analyze issues, and recommend solutions.
  13. Model professionalism in virtual and in-person settings (responsiveness, meeting etiquette) and promote an inclusive, accountable, and collaborative team culture.
  14. Stay current on relevant standards, regulations, and industry trends affecting nonprofit and government contractor clients; maintain proficiency in the OAAS technology stack and modern cloud-based accounting tools.

Other (Secondary) Functions:

  1. Acts as an instructor in professional development programs.
  2. Prepares other reports and projects as requested from time to time by the partners.
  3. Such other duties as may be assigned.
  4. Participates in firm's practice and proposal development efforts.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting and at relevant experience in public accounting/outsourced accounting, demonstrating a progression in complexity, scope, and number of engagements managed. Typically 5-10 years’ experience, but this is highly dependent on the type of experience.
  • CPA preferred but not required

Demonstrated Skill and Ability Requirements:

  • Effective written and oral communications with employees, partners, and clients, and vendors.
  • Organize projects set priorities and delegate tasks under constantly changing circumstances for different clients and partners
  • Assume lead role in planning and implementing assigned projects
  • Keep long term objectives in mind while focusing on daily activities
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive firm and client information
  • Demonstrated ability to bring in new business

Continuing Accounting Educational Requirements:

  • Minimum of forty hours of continuing professional education is required each year to maintain and develop technical and business skills, as well as to maintain license requirements.
  • Participates in career development program to improve managerial, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Acts as mentor to less experienced staff

Required Licenses, Certificates or Knowledge:

  • Proficiency in use of modern accounting technology such as QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, Bill.com, Nexonia, Excel, Generative AI, etc.

Benefits

This is a full-time position. Our office is located two blocks from the Bethesda Metro Station (red line). We offer a competitive benefits package, including a 401(k) plan with profit sharing, employer-supported medical coverage, company-paid life and disability insurance, student loan repayment, generous PTO, and a culture that fosters flexibility and career development. We look forward to hearing from you!

GRF CPAs & Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. At GRF CPAs and Advisors, we cultivate an inclusive business environment where all employees are valued for their unique contributions to our mission to provide exceptional financial, tax and consulting services to our clients in the US and around the world.

About The Chicago School

The Chicago School is a nonprofit university with seven in-person locations across the United States, a growing online campus, and education partnerships worldwide. The Chicago School is a minority-majority university with 6,000+ students across 35+ degree programs in psychology, behavioral health, and nursing. The Chicago School is committed to creating a diverse pipeline of future professionals who will fundamentally improve the health and well-being of future generations of diverse communities. Founded in 1979 by a group of psychologists and educators, The Chicago School has grown into a dominant and globally respected leader in the fields of psychology and behavioral health sciences. Today, The Chicago School has an annual operating budget of nearly $150M and employs nearly 600 full-time faculty and staff. As an institution, The Chicago School is deeply committed to student success, innovation, and community impact. Our students are meaningfully connected in their communities, donating more than 1.2 million service hours per year through fieldwork and practicum opportunities. The Chicago School is part of the TCS Education System, a nonprofit system of colleges advancing student success and community impact.

Position Summary:

The Research Compliance Specialist provides comprehensive support for the institution’s research compliance program, including compliance monitoring and education and training. The Specialist will conduct compliance assessments, support audits, and partner with academic and administrative units to promote research integrity and accountability. The Specialist will also develop and deliver human research protections training for faculty, staff, and students and create educational materials, coordinate workshops and webinars, and partner with academic units to strengthen ethical research practices throughout the institution. This role serves as a key resource for faculty, staff, and external partners, ensuring adherence to federal regulations, institutional policies, and best practices in human subjects research.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

Research Compliance Monitoring & Auditing

  • Conduct for-cause audits authorized by the IRB or institutional official.
  • Conduct periodic compliance reviews of research protocols and documentation.
  • Write reports and communicate findings with investigators, committees, and appropriate parties.
  • Monitor adherence to IRB determinations, continuing review obligations, and reporting requirements.
  • Support internal audits relating to research governance.
  • Identify potential compliance gaps and recommend corrective action.
  • Collaborate with IRB and sponsored programs offices to maintain compliance frameworks.

Education & Training

  • Design and implement training programs on IRB submission processes, federal regulations, and best practices in human subject protections for both socio-behavioral and biomedical research.
  • Develop written and multimedia resources (guides, FAQs, webinars).
  • Partner with departments to offer tailored training sessions and support.
  • Track training participation and recommend improvements to curricula.
  • Stay current with regulatory changes and emerging trends in research compliance education.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned by the IRB Director.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g., research compliance, public health, social sciences, etc.) and 3 years relevant program experience.
  • Experience with human subjects research, IRB operations, research compliance, education and training.
  • Familiarity with compliance auditing or monitoring practices.
  • Knowledge of federal regulations governing research and institutional policies.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training programs or educational materials.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative and service-oriented approach.
  • Discretion and professionalism in handling sensitive information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic research/compliance systems.
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment using tools such as Zoom.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in higher education or academic research administration.
  • Experience using Cayuse.
  • Certification in research or compliance (e.g., CIP, CCRC, CIM, CHRC, CUNY, RCI).

Position Summary:

Minimizes risk to the organization by conducting Corporate Compliance audits, investigations and training throughout all affiliates. Guides system administration and RGHS management to ensure compliance with local, state and federal laws and regulations; in addition to contract obligations. Acts as subject matter expert for building and continually optimizing the system’s EMR. Work is often confidential and sensitive; therefore requires a high level of professionalism and strong communication skills. Requires a high degree of mental and visual acuity as attention to detail, critical thinking and decision making is required. Errors greatly impact the hospital’s compliance risk, including legal fines, loss of revenue and statistics. Strong analytical skills, project management experience, and training skills to guide Physicians, staff and system Management in interpretation of rules and regulations are essential.

Status: Full-Time

Department: Compliance

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm

Key Responsibilities:

• Abides by the standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association.

• Manages projects independently, prepares governmental disclosures and facilitates external audits by regulatory agencies while working with RGHS Administration and Management.

• Coordinates and conducts audits to assess compliance with payer regulations and contract obligations. Audits include, but not limited to revenue cycle (Clinical documentation, EMR work flows, registration, coding, charging, billing, payments and denials), financial statements, payments and attestations; grants, RGHS employees and contractors for governmental exclusions and payment agreements

• Interviews key staff with professionalism and respect in order to identify cause analysis of issues identified.

• Collaborates with health care professionals to discuss findings and offer advice and education as to how to improve compliance

• Develops reports reflecting audit results and reports findings to Compliance Director, RGHS Administration and management

• Develops corrective action plans with Management and assists with implementation when necessary.

• Performs follow up audits to ensure monitors are implemented and effective.

• Analyzes studies that have been prepared by government and professional associations to assess risk and opportunity for assigned departments

• Identifies compliance benchmarks for assigned areas and performs analysis for risk assessment

• Collaborates with System Directors and/or administration regularly to ensure awareness of any regulation changes impacting their departments

• Researches and assists Compliance Director, RGHS management and administration with approvals for new business growth for the system

• Approves and collaborates with system management and administration on margin improvement initiatives, often times assists or provides the training to staff involved in implementing, to ensure compliance

• Acts as Subject Matter Expert in the continued building and optimization of the systems EMR in areas of clinical documentation, work flows and impacts on the revenue cycle to ensure compliance. Performs presentations for clinicians on appropriate documentation in the EMR

• Designs and implements training to ensure compliance. Focuses include, but not limited to Fraud, Waste and Abuse, revenue cycle clinical documentation, coding, charging, billing and denial appeals for physicians, health care providers, HIM coders and other applicable RGHS employees

• Performs and manages internal investigations into reports of non compliance (fraud, waste and abuse) by RGHS employees or external sources as directed

• Interviews system management and staff with respect and professionalism

• Completes report and investigation in a timely manner

• Reports findings to Compliance Director and follows through as directed; including assisting HR with information and interviews to ensure appropriate discipline of employees

• Performs cause analysis of non compliance

• Facilitates corrective action and monitors in affected departments with management

• Performs follow up audits in timely manner to ensure compliance

• Facilitates and manages under the general direction of Compliance Director external investigations into the system by agencies such as OIG, DOJ, OMIG, FBI, Medicare and Third Party payer fraud units. Represents the system in a positive and professional manner when communicating with agencies.

Minimum Qualifications:

• AAS or BS in Health Information Management, Health Care Administration, Finance, or Accounting, and experience with healthcare compliance. A combination of healthcare work experience, credentials and/or education will be considered.
• Minimum five years of healthcare experience with CMS and local payers regulations.

Required Licensure/Certification Skills:

• RHIT, RHIA, CCS or CCS-P preferred.

  • Relevant health care related certification or other experience may be considered in lieu of above certifications.
    • Compliance Board Certification a plus

Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatched expertise and patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding $2 billion. The award-winning platform covers major marketplaces and ad channels for optimal reach. The result is unprecedented granularity, smarter budgeting, and bespoke solutions for retailers.

Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. As a business, we value the enrichment that diversity brings to our organization and are committed to a culture that creates a sense of inclusion and belonging. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

OVERVIEW:

We’re looking for a Customer Strategy Manager to join our rapidly growing Customer Strategy team.

As a Customer Strategy Manager, you will be exposed to all facets of the business and be encouraged to learn and develop skills both within and beyond your role. This role will manage Quartile’s partnership across mid-market accounts, including responsibility for communication, strategy, and serving as a thought leader.

The Customer Strategy Manager candidate is an intelligent, motivated person that enjoys working with clients to solve business challenges.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience working with small to medium sized businesses in a client facing role
  • A proven track record of using data to drive strategic decision making; analytical in nature (our clients and partners are all in an ROI driven industry)
  • Above average skills with Microsoft Excel (command over formulas, vlookups, pivot tables, etc.) and analytics platforms, etc.
  • Talented presenter with ability to captivate an audience and leverage data to tell a story
  • Capable of solving problems - maintaining a positive outlook when tackling challenges and coming up with solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to be professionally outspoken when managing tough customer conversations to yield positive results
  • English proficiency required—must be able to speak and write in the language fluently

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Background in the e-commerce or retail industry
  • Experience working with digital marketing platforms and channels - Google Analytics, Bing, Facebook, Amazon ads
  • Google AdWords or Google Analytics certification
  • Amazon certification
  • Experience in a fast-paced, startup environment
  • Experience in the advertising/ad tech industry

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Maintain direct ownership of 15+ key mid-market accounts - monitoring KPIs, diagnosing underperformance, and building data-backed optimization recommendations.
  • Manage client expectations and leading regular (weekly or bi-weekly) meetings with the client
  • Analyze key metrics of online marketing campaigns and present key findings and insights to clients
  • Oversee client performance, collaborating with strategists to make optimizations to paid marketing campaigns
  • Prepare client reporting and quarterly business reviews to align Quartile value and client expectations
  • Serve as a strategic partner for clients as a subject matter expert in the areas of digital marketing, e-commerce and retail.
  • Utilize data to expose awesome new opportunities for technology improvements and exposing them to our Product and Technology teams
  • Be a Quartile product expert by attending product training and roadmap sessions
  • Evaluate opportunities to grow Quartile’s partnership with their customers (new channel expansion, additional budget, testing opportunities, case studies, etc.)
  • Partner with Implementation team to develop overarching department strategy and the setup of new clients during onboarding process

This is a PJ contract based out in Brazil.

Job Description Summary



This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager.

Ready to help shape how innovative medicines reach patients and healthcare providers across the healthcare ecosystem? As the Associate Director, Market Access Contracting, you will play a critical role in developing and managing market access agreements across Managed Care, Medi-care, Advanced Platforms, and Channel contracts. Partnering closely with pricing, account management, finance, legal, and market access leaders, you'll help drive contracting strategies that support patient access, business growth, and commercial success. This is an exciting opportunity for a strategic and analytically minded professional to influence key decisions, navigate complex market dynamics, and make a meaningful impact across one of the most critical areas of the business.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serving as the central point of contact for the pricing and channel strategy teams, account management, legal, Managed Markets Finance (MMF) operations, government pricing, and senior leadership on all contracting matters related to a designated account list or segment.
  • Working with pricing, channel strategy, and account management in the development of contract proposals and effective negotiation strategies, including working with customer accounts directly in negotiation of contractual documentation.
  • Collaborating with the pricing and channel strategy teams to develop and assess brand contracting strategies.
  • Serve as primary liaison to MMF to ensure accurate understanding and interpretation of contract changes. Provide general oversight to discount and rebate operations team and serve as an approver of various contract price determinations and payment types related to market access contracts (e.g., Managed Care and Medicare rebate payments, GPO, channel, and customer contract price and rebate payments).
  • Support market access teams in managing contract amendments, renewal timeline tracking and execution, and the development of new contracting templates.
  • Ensure all contracts are completed according to determined SLAs and SOPs
  • Preparing regular reports and dashboards for management, key internal stakeholders across market access and brand teams, and external stakeholders to supplement customer and account business and performance reviews. Reporting will include but not limited to formulary tracking, rate tracking, invoice tracking, growth and performance-based rebate tracking across customers and/or channel segments, and general reporting of market share using both claims, IQVIA, sales, and chargeback data.
  • Responsible for accurate and timely reporting of formulary changes in NEXUS across Managed Care and Medicare accounts.
  • Engage on an ongoing basis with MMF Gross to Net forecasting team to review contract changes, actual blended rates forecasted blended rates, and associated P&L implications for each account.
  • Responsible for SOX documentation and compliance with periodic internal and external audits.

Essential Requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or Law preferred; advanced degree (i.e., MBA) a plus
  • Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience
  • Experience in contract reviewing/writing, account measurement, reporting, and forecasting.
  • Advanced understanding of legal aspects of contracts and contract interpretation as well as potential pricing impacts. Ability to manage complex contracts and understand potential pricing impacts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex information and data sets in an understandable and compelling manner.
  • Excellent financial and analytical skills and acumen

Desirable Requirements:

  • Extensive knowledge of pharmaceutical and market access contracting and its market segments
  • Experience in all commercial, managed care, and channel environments (HMOs, IPAs, PBMs, GPOs, LTCs, and Specialty Pharmacies), and knowledge of the Medicare contracting marketplace.

Novartis Compensation Summary:

The salary for this position is expected to range between $160,300 and $297,700 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

Join AORN and Make an Impact

The Association of periOperative Registered Nurses (AORN) is seeking a Sr Manager, Segment Marketing – Nursing and Consumer Products to help advance patient and staff safety through evidence-based practice, education, and clinical resources that support perioperative nurses. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and career stages who are excited to bring their expertise to a mission-driven organization.

In this role, you will lead audience-focused marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, and growth across AORN's membership, publications, events, and consumer product offerings. By leveraging data, market insights, and cross-functional collaboration, you will help strengthen customer relationships, expand AORN's impact, and connect perioperative professionals with the resources they need to succeed.

Location: Remote
Headquarters: Denver, CO

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Make a meaningful impact on patient and staff safety.
  • Work remotely with a collaborative and supportive team.
  • Contribute ideas that help shape the future of perioperative nursing.
  • Join a culture that values innovation, inclusion, and professional growth.

Why Join AORN?

At AORN, you'll find purpose-driven work, an engaging remote culture, and a team dedicated to advancing perioperative nursing.

Our values guide everything we do:

  • Innovation:Taking courageous and bold actions for growth and sustainability.
  • Communication:Exemplifying respect, collaboration, transparency and honesty.
  • Quality:Ensuring accountability and excellence.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusiveness:Promoting fairness, valuing differences, considering all perspectives.
  • Achievement:Achieving our mission, realizing the vision.

Whether you're early in your career or bringing years of expertise, you'll have the opportunity to contribute and make a difference.

What You’ll Do

As the strategic marketing leader for AORN's Nursing and Consumer Products portfolio, including Membership, Publications, EXPO attendance, event registration, and other consumer offerings, you will develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that drive customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue growth. Working closely with leaders across the organization, you will leverage audience insights, segmentation, and data-driven marketing to deliver impactful campaigns, strengthen customer relationships, and support business objectives. In addition, you will lead and mentor marketing team members while collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to optimize performance, identify growth opportunities, and advance AORN's mission through compelling customer experiences.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the segment marketing strategy for AORN's Nursing and Consumer Products portfolio, including Membership, EXPO, publications, and other B2C offerings.
  • Develop audience segmentation, personas, messaging, and value propositions that drive engagement, lead generation, and revenue growth.
  • Translate market, member, and customer insights into effective go-to-market strategies and customer experiences.
  • Plan and execute integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns that support acquisition, retention, renewal, and re-engagement objectives.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to align marketing initiatives, product positioning, and growth strategies with organizational goals.
  • Leverage data, analytics, and market intelligence to evaluate performance, optimize campaigns, and identify new opportunities.
  • Oversee the development and quality of marketing assets, content, sales enablement materials, and customer-facing communications.
  • Monitor and report on key performance indicators, providing strategic recommendations to drive business results.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor marketing team members while managing priorities, resources, and project delivery.
  • Foster strong partnerships across Membership, Education, Events, Sales, Advocacy, and other teams to advance AORN's mission.

What You’ll Bring

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, healthcare administration or related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive marketing experience with responsibility for product marketing, segment marketing, audience marketing, or go-to-market strategy.
  • Minimum of 5 years of B2C product marketing experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and revenue growth.
  • Demonstrated experience developing customer segmentation, positioning, messaging, and lifecycle marketing strategies.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience managing a team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience marketing products or services within healthcare (medical, hospitals, or related healthcare industries), with a strong preference for engagement of nursing or other clinical professional audiences.
  • Experience working for a membership association with responsibility for membership growth, product marketing, or revenue generation.
  • Experience in an agency setting, internal or external.
  • Market sales/strategy experience.
  • Experience with best practices for digital and traditional channels.
  • Proficiency with marketing technology (CMS, CRM, marketing automation, paid media, social, analytics).

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Deep understanding of the healthcare landscape and healthcare buyer dynamics.
  • Exceptional communication skills including writing, presenting, reporting; ability to translate complex clinical/operational concepts into clear, compelling value.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration across levels and functions.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple priorities with on‑time delivery.
  • Ability to demonstrate and hold others accountable for organizational values of: Innovation, Communication, Quality, Diversity, Equity and inclusion, and Achievement.

Benefits & Well-Being

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your health, well-being, financial future, and professional growth.

Supporting Your Health & Well-Being

  • Medical coverage, including PPO and HDHP options
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Employer-paid life insurance
  • Employer-paid short-term disability insurance
  • Long-term disability insurance available
  • Critical illness and accident insurance options
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Free Calm subscription
  • Pet insurance

  • Staff incentive bonus opportunity

Supporting Your Life Outside of Work

  • Generous paid time off
  • 10 paid holidays annually
  • Paid sick leave
  • Paid parental leave
  • Up to 8 hours of paid volunteer time annually
  • Remote work

Supporting Your Professional Growth

  • Access to Udemy learning resources
  • Professional development opportunities

Working Conditions

This remote position requires regular use of a computer, Microsoft Teams, and other business technology tools. Travel may be required to support departmental and Association activities.

raw.description:
Overview:

The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic digital transformation program. The goals of the program are to grow revenue through new and transformed digital-first trust and agency service products, to move from a product-centric to client-centric operating model, to move from market-specific to global solutions, and to dramatically lower the cost to serve.


Wilmington Trust is seeking an Appian Forward Deployed Product Owner to accelerate the modernization of Bond Management capabilities and the operational workflows supporting Corporate Trust products and services.This role is designed for an experienced product, business analysis, or transformation professional who can operate close to business users, translate operational needs into deployable digital workflows, and help lead iterative delivery in a regulated financial services environment.


This role combines Product Ownership, business process transformation, and hands-on Appian workflow design responsibilities within a regulated financial services environment. The role requires hands-on Appian experience, strong business process and analytical skills, and the ability to partner across business, operations, technology, risk, and product stakeholders to move quickly from discovery to working solutions.


Ideal candidates will be comfortable owning product outcomes, facilitating working sessions, writing stories and specifications, validating build quality, and using AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, prototyping, testing, and workflow improvement.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Design, configure, and improve business process workflows using Appian Designer, with a focus on speed to value, user-centric design, reuse, governance, and operational control.
  • Lead business process discovery across Bond Management operations, including debt servicing, transfer agent, paying agent, waterfall accounting, and exception management processes.
  • Identify automation opportunities, document current state pain points, and establish baseline measures for effort, cycle time, exception volume, straight-through processing, and control effectiveness.
  • Define value hypotheses, business outcomes, and success measures to guide workflow prioritization, backlog decisions, and benefit realization.
  • Apply Appian to modernize Bond Management workflows across debt servicing, transfer agent, paying agent, waterfall accounting, exception management, and related operational control processes.
  • Partner closely with business product owners, operations leaders, technology teams, and risk partners to gather requirements, map processes, define user needs, and prioritize workflow improvements.
  • Own and manage product backlog items, including authoring, refining, and grooming user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, process flows, UI concepts, test scenarios, and release-ready requirements.
  • Lead stakeholder working sessions to define current-state and future-state workflows, identify friction points, iterate on MVP designs, resolve issues, and drive alignment across business and technology teams.
  • Build, configure, and maintain workflows in Appian Designer, leveraging out-of-the-box components wherever possible to accelerate delivery, support consistency, and reduce the need for custom development.
  • Use AI-assisted and agentic AI tools to accelerate discovery, process analysis, requirements documentation, story drafting, workflow prototyping, test case generation, defect analysis, and delivery communications.
  • Own assigned Bond Management workflow outcomes from discovery through configuration, validation, pilot adoption, and post release optimization; establish baselines and measure realized improvements in straight-through processing, exception volume, cycle time, manual effort, control effectiveness, and user adoption.
  • Support QA, UAT, regression testing, and production validation by defining test scenarios, validating builds, documenting defects, gathering issue resolution requirements, and confirming readiness for release.
  • Partner with technology teams on integration points, data dependencies, security considerations, platform constraints, and production support needs.
  • · Keep current with Appian capabilities, including Appian AI, Case Management Studio, RPA, data fabric, reporting, and platform governance, and recommend opportunities to apply new capabilities responsibly.
  • Champion Appian best practices around governance, reusability, modular design, versioning, packaging, maintainability, and controlled delivery in a regulated environment.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies, including daily standups, planning sessions, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Build and maintain Appian reports and dashboards to track workflow performance, user activity, operational quality, and business metrics; partner with senior stakeholders to define meaningful KPIs.
  • Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
  • Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
  • Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
  • Complete other related duties as assigned.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 10 years’ business, analytical, technical, digital product, transformation, or product ownership experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 14 years’ higher education and/or relevant work experience, including a minimum of 10 years’ business, analytical, technical, digital product, transformation, or product ownership experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Appian, including experience building, configuring, testing, or supporting workflows, forms, interfaces, records, process models, reports, dashboards, or related Appian objects.
  • Experience in financial services and/or fintech, including exposure to regulated business processes, operational risk, client service, banking, wealth management, trust services, payments, capital markets, lending, compliance, or similar domains.
  • Experience operating as a product owner, product analyst, business analyst, transformation lead, or workflow designer in an agile or iterative delivery environment.
  • Experience writing detailed, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, specifications, process flows, business rules, UI concepts, testing scenarios, or release documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems, assess operational impacts, analyze data or process evidence, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Exposure to QA, UAT, regression testing, defect triage, test case development, production validation, or other solution quality practices.
  • Working knowledge of AI-assisted tools or agentic AI concepts and the ability to use AI responsibly to improve analysis, documentation, testing, prototyping, or workflow delivery.
  • Ability to bridge business and technical teams, translating needs into executable solutions and explaining technical constraints, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to stakeholders.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to facilitate working sessions, present recommendations, document decisions, and drive alignment across teams.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and deliver in a fast-paced, regulated transformation environment.

Education and Experience Preferred:

  • Appian Level 1 or higher certification, or equivalent hands-on experience with Appian Designer.
  • Familiarity with SAIL expressions for configuring dynamic forms, validations, conditional logic, and reusable interface patterns.
  • Understanding of Appian object reusability, versioning, packaging, release management, performance considerations, and platform governance best practices.
  • Experience with Appian AI, Case Management Studio, Appian RPA, data fabric, connected systems, integrations, or document management workflows.
  • Experience using agentic AI or AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Open Claw, Hermes, or similar tools to support product analysis, prototyping, testing, documentation, or automation.
  • Experience with low-code or no-code workflow platforms beyond Appian, such as Power Platform, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Pega, Airtable, Retool, Mendix, or similar tools.
  • Corporate Trust, securities servicing, bond administration, transfer agent, paying agent, or financial operations domain experience is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of business process mapping, process engineering, service design, user journey design, and operational improvement methods.
  • Experience developing, managing, or launching digital capabilities in financial services, fintech, trust services, institutional services, compliance, legal operations, or document-intensive environments.
  • Experience working in partnership with user experience, design, data, architecture, cybersecurity, risk, legal, compliance, or operations teams.
  • Knowledge of Agile, Lean, design thinking, systems thinking, and continuous improvement principles and practices.
M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $148,300.00 - $247,100.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. The range listed above corresponds to our national pay range for this role. The specific pay range applicable to you may vary based on your location.

raw.excerpt: About ZensaiZensai is the Human Success company.  Our agentic AI platform coaches employees and managers through learning, performance, and engagement, natively inside Microsoft 365.
raw.description:
About Zensai

Zensai is the Human Success company. Our agentic AI platform coaches employees and managers through learning, performance, and engagement, natively inside Microsoft 365. More than 2,000 organizations use Zensai to make development part of how work happens, rather than a separate HR destination.

We believe the more AI we have, the more human we need to be. This role is where that belief meets our customers.

Why this role exists

Our biggest growth opportunity sits with the customers we already have. Over the next few years we plan to grow 3.6x from our existing customer base — and that growth depends on customers who stay, adopt more, and move up our editions.

You are Marketing's person in North America for that customer base. You know our customers in the region better than anyone in Marketing: who they are, what they're trying to achieve, where they're thriving, and where they're at risk. You turn that understanding into programs that keep customers engaged, grow accounts, and surface the stories that help us win more.

This is a marketing role that shows up with Sales. Under our go-to-market model, each region runs as a cross-functional pod — AEs, AMs, CSMs, solution and GTM engineers, and marketing — aligned around the customer. You're a member of the North America pod: in customer meetings, in sales meetings, and in the room when regional priorities are set. You know the region's objectives as well as the people carrying the number.

This is a generalist customer marketing role with a commercial number attached. You'll work hand in hand with Customer Success and Account Managers in the region, alongside our Lifecycle Marketing Manager and the central marketing team.

Where you sit

Solid line - Marketing — priorities, standards, brand and messaging, performance review, career development

Dotted line - RVP Sales, North America — regional revenue priorities, target accounts, program focus

Closest partners - Customer Success Managers and Account Managers in North America · Lifecycle Marketing Manager · Product Marketing · Brand & Content · GTM Engineering

Counterpart - Customer Growth Marketing Manager, EMEA — one shared playbook, two regions

Regional pod - AEs, AMs, CSMs, SE/GTM Engineer, BDR, Channel in North America

Cadence you join - Weekly working session with the RVP · weekly pipeline review and forecast call · weekly account and renewal review with CS and AMs · customer and sales meetings · monthly regional business review · quarterly planning with central marketing

Where regional and central priorities conflict, Marketing leadership and the RVP resolve it together. You flag early rather than absorb the trade-off.

What you own

  • The regional customer strategy — the North America customer marketing plan, set with the RVP and regional commercial leadership.

  • Expansion pipeline and ARR influenced by your programs in North America.

  • Retention contribution — at-risk accounts reached and re-engaged before renewal.

  • Customer stories — a steady supply of case studies, references, reviews, and speakers from the region.

  • Program performance — what worked, what didn't, and what we do next, reported monthly.

What you'll do

Set the regional strategy

  • Own the plan: set the North America customer marketing strategy in partnership with the RVP, regional sales, and commercial leadership — which customers, which industries, which programs, and what each should deliver.

  • Tie it to the number: build the plan from the region's revenue, renewal, and expansion objectives, and revisit it every quarter.

  • Report back: bring program-sourced pipeline, expansion ARR influenced, and retention results into each regional business review.

Show up with Sales

  • In the meetings: join customer meetings, account planning, pipeline reviews, and forecast calls — so programs are built against live regional priorities, not a central calendar.

  • Run the matrix cadence: hold a standing weekly working session with the RVP to agree priorities, target accounts, and success measures.

  • Be the connector: share engagement and risk signals with AEs, AMs, and CSMs so they know where to act first, and make sure handoffs between marketing and the commercial team are tight.

Know the customer base, deeply

  • Build the regional picture: segment customers by industry, edition, size, adoption, and renewal date — and know which accounts are ready to grow and which are drifting.

  • Understand motivations: what CHROs, HR and L&D leaders, and IT leaders in our customer base care about, and what makes them stay.

  • Bring the customer into the room: share what you learn with Product Marketing, Brand, and Sales so it shapes positioning, content, and roadmap conversations.

Turn signals into programs

  • Risk signals: working with the Lifecycle Marketing Manager and CS, design programs that respond to falling usage, champion changes, low engagement, or upcoming renewals — before they become churn.

  • Growth signals: spot accounts showing expansion intent and build plays with AMs to act on them.

  • Test and refine: agree what each program should move, measure it, and keep what works.

Run industry programs

  • Vertical-first: design industry-specific programs for our key sectors in North America — such as financial services, legal, manufacturing, healthcare, professional services, and retail.

  • Relevant content: work with Brand & Content to build stories, guides, and proof that speak to each industry's real challenges.

Grow accounts

  • Expansion programs: partner with AMs to run edition moves (Grow → Scale → Transform), cross-sell, and adoption programs such as Copilot readiness.

  • Account plays: run targeted programs for high-potential customer accounts, with account lists agreed with the RVP and AMs.

  • Equip the team: design offers, plays, templates, and talk tracks that AEs, AMs, and CSMs can take straight to customers — with consistent messaging across the portfolio and regions, and clear follow-up actions for every program.

Create moments that matter

  • Customer moments in region: user groups, roundtables, executive dinners, webinars, and moments around the major US HR and L&D events — designed to connect customers with each other and with Zensai.

  • Community: work with our Head of Community so regional moments feed the wider Zensai community.

Find and tell the right stories

  • Source the stories: identify customers with outcomes worth sharing and bring them forward for case studies, video, references, reviews, and speaking slots.

  • Build advocates: grow a bench of customers who will speak for Zensai — and look after them.

Work with the central team

  • Central builds, region deploys: use central brand, product marketing, and lifecycle programs, and adapt them for your region rather than starting from scratch.

  • Use AI well: use AI and our signal tools (HubSpot, Dynamics 365, Gong, Dreamdata, Clay) for research, segmentation, and first drafts — and keep the judgment, the stories, and the customer relationships human.

What you'll bring

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, ideally in customer, lifecycle, or account-based marketing.

  • Customer-first instinct — you enjoy talking to customers and you're genuinely curious about what drives them.

  • Comfort with numbers — you can read usage, renewal, and pipeline data, find the story in it, and decide what to do.

  • Program builder — you've designed and run multi-touch programs end to end, from idea to results.

  • Commercial partnering — you've worked inside or alongside sales and CS teams, joined customer conversations, and earned their trust.

  • Matrix experience — you can deliver to a commercial leader while holding one marketing standard.

  • Clear communicator — excellent written and spoken English.

  • Tool fluency — confident with HubSpot (preferred) and a CRM such as Dynamics 365 or Salesforce; comfortable using AI tools every day.

  • Self-starter — comfortable owning a region and working across time zones with the central team.

Benefits

Time for Life: We offer employees 25 days of PTO plus 11 federal holidays, and we provide 6 months of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 months for secondary caregivers.

401(k) that stands out: We match up to 6% from day one. Your future, growing faster.

Health cover that starts day 1: We pay 70% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family, with two plans plus HSA.

We provide 6 months of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 months for secondary caregivers.

Learning: 10% of your working time dedicated to development. Built in, not squeezed in.

Peace of mind: Company-paid life insurance (2× salary), disability cover, and AD&D.

Wellbeing perks: Free Headspace family plan, fitness membership (gyms, yoga, apps), and a 24/7 support line with counselling.

Summary

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Heavy Duty Diesel Mechanic to join our team, responsible for performing comprehensive repairs and preventative maintenance on a variety of heavy-duty diesel vehicles, including trucks, buses, and industrial equipment. The successful candidate will work with mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, ensuring all work is performed efficiently, safely, and according to industry standards. Additionally, the mechanic will provide support to customers both in person and through remote or virtual consultations, advising on necessary repairs or maintenance, ensuring equipment operates according to manufacturer specifications, and maintaining detailed service documentation to support both in-shop and virtual interactions. Candidates must have a modern smartphone with an active internet connection to efficiently manage orders and assignments through the company app. Proficiency in navigating mobile applications, digital platforms, and app-based workflows is essential for seamless task execution and communication.

Compensation ranges from $52,000 to $93,600 per year, based on experience and availability.

Job Specifics

  • Diagnose and repair mechanical issues in heavy-duty diesel vehicles, including trucks, buses, and other industrial equipment.
  • Perform engine rebuilding, maintenance, and inspections to ensure optimal vehicle performance.
  • Work on hydraulic and pneumatic systems, as well as complete brake repairs and other system-related issues.
  • Complete preventative maintenance tasks, ensuring vehicles are ready for safe operation.
  • Test vehicle performance and identify areas requiring repair or replacement.
  • Follow all safety protocols and regulatory guidelines while performing tasks.
  • Maintain accurate service records and documentation.
  • Ensure that work is completed efficiently and within set timelines.

Qualifications and Experience


Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in heavy-duty diesel repair.
  • Strong knowledge of diesel engines, hydraulic systems, and pneumatic systems.
  • Ability to work independently and complete tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety standards.

Experience

  • ASE certification in Diesel Mechanics or related field.
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL).
  • Over 5 years of experience in heavy-duty diesel repair, including advanced diesel systems.

Why Join Us?

Our innovative approach to remote mechanic jobs is reshaping the industry, offering unparalleled opportunities for skilled professionals like you. By joining our team, you'll be at the forefront of this revolution, leveraging cutting-edge technology to provide expert services from anywhere. With flexible schedules and the ability to work remotely, you'll enjoy greater freedom and autonomy in your career. Plus, our commitment to inclusivity ensures that every team member is valued and supported. If you're ready to be part of a forward-thinking organization that's changing the game for mechanics, apply now and embark on a rewarding journey with us.

About Company

At our organization, we're on a mission to revolutionize the opportunities available in the mechanic industry by pioneering remote mechanic jobs. We believe that skilled mechanics shouldn't be limited by traditional brick-and-mortar settings but should have the flexibility to work remotely, leveraging technology to provide expert services wherever they're needed. By embracing remote work, we're empowering mechanics to optimize their schedules, reduce commuting time, and expand their reach to serve clients beyond geographical boundaries. Through innovative platforms and robust support systems, we're creating a new paradigm in the mechanic industry, one that prioritizes efficiency, accessibility, and inclusivity. Join us in shaping the future of remote mechanics and unlocking endless possibilities for professionals in the field.

About Us

Pacific Defense is a leading developer of advanced electronics systems for the U.S. Department of Defense and commercial customers. Our team specializes in Open Systems Architecture solutions for the non-kinetic fight, providing customers with cost-effective, modular, and rapidly reconfigurable systems in record time. We deliver sensing and effects solutions for land, air, sea, and space domains, leveraging open standards and rapid prototyping methodologies to bring innovative capabilities to the market. Pacific Defense has built an excellent reputation in the defense industry and is expanding our team to tackle new challenges and opportunities. Join us and accelerate your career!

We are looking to hire a Senior PCB Engineer who wants to get involved with a small, fast-paced and dynamic company. This position requires strong PCB design skills and experience with creating, documenting, and maintaining design processes. Expected to work well with both internal and external designers as well as contractors. Must be able to establish strong relationships and interface with our internal engineers (hardware & mechanical), external contractors (PCB Designers), and board fabrication/assembly contracting houses.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of PCB layout and routing experience with Allegro preferred.
  • 10+ years designing, high-speed digital and mixed signal PCBs starting from schematic netlists generated by other design engineers
  • Experienced designing with high speed digital rates > 10 Gbps and > 6 GHz
  • Experienced designing with high-speed memory interfaces such as DDR4
  • Experienced designing boards with 16+ layers using buried and blind vias
  • Experienced with controlled impedance transmission lines, including single-ended and differential stripline, microstrip and coplanar waveguide.
  • Experienced creating and documenting standard processes to build symbols and footprints (decals), and ensure processes are followed
  • Experienced creating and maintaining schematic symbols and PCB footprints for the entire hardware design group. May require leading a junior designer to help create and check new footprints.
  • Experienced with designing to meet IPC requirements
  • Experienced creating and documenting PCB design processes for both internal use and for use by contract PCB designers, and ensure processes are followed
  • Experienced working closely with contract PCB designers to ensure our design processes are followed and deliverables meet our standard requirements
  • Must have excellent oral and written communication skills

Education

  • Requirement: Relevant industry experience
  • Preferred: BS or Associate’s Degree in EE/CE/CS or Computer Aided Drafting & Design

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with digital design engineers during parts placement and signal routing to ensure PCB design meets all requirements
  • Collaborate with mechanical design engineers to ensure mechanical integrity as well as thermal requirements are met
  • Work closely with PCB design contractors to ensure design processes and deliverables are met
  • Work closely with PCB fab houses to ensure our PCB design requirements are met and resolve issues during PCB fabrication
  • Work closely with contract assembly houses to clarify any design requirements and resolve issues prior to and during PCB assembly
  • Manage a centralized library of footprints to ensure consistency and reliability
  • Lead design reviews of internal and external PCB layouts

Benefits

Pacific Defense provides competitive salaries and an immediately vested 401K match. We provide 100% coverage options for the employee and 75% coverage for dependents’ medical, dental, vision, and life insurance premiums, and a flexible spending account for incidental health care expenses. We offer generous paid time off and federal holidays to spend time with family, pursue outside interests, or just get some extra rest.

Pacific Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor.
